products.title: 丙酮、异丙醇尾气水吸收装置
products.summary: 针对丙酮、异丙醇等水溶性有机尾气，采用两级水吸收、循环冷却和富液外送回收工艺，实现尾气净化与资源化处理。
products.summaryEn: A two-stage water absorption system for water-soluble VOCs such as acetone and isopropanol, using circulating absorption liquid, cooling and rich-liquid recovery.
products.detail: 丙酮、异丙醇属于与水互溶、易被水相吸收的典型水溶性VOCs。该装置通过预处理、一级吸收、二级精吸收、循环液冷却和富液外送回收等单元，将尾气中的丙酮、异丙醇转移至吸收液中，净化后的气体经排气筒达标排放。
products.customFlowTitle: 丙酮、异丙醇尾气水吸收动态流程图
products.customFlowTitleEn: Dynamic Water Absorption Process for Acetone and Isopropanol Tail Gas
detailParagraphs: 工艺叙述
丙酮、异丙醇均具有较强亲水性，适合采用水吸收方式对高浓度或中等浓度尾气进行净化与回收预处理。尾气经收集后先进入预处理段，去除夹带液滴、粉尘或冷凝杂质，减少对吸收塔填料和循环系统的影响。
预处理后的有机尾气依次进入一级吸收塔和二级吸收塔，与循环吸收水逆流接触。丙酮、异丙醇由气相转移至液相，净化后的气体由塔顶进入排气筒，按项目排放要求进行达标排放。
循环吸收液经循环泵输送，并通过冷却器控制液相温度，以提高吸收推动力和系统稳定性。随着吸收液中有机物浓度升高，富集吸收液进入储槽，可外送回收、进入精馏分离或接入厂区后续废水/溶剂回收系统。
系统特点
该工艺流程清晰，设备结构相对简单，适用于丙酮、异丙醇等水溶性强、可通过液相吸收实现转移的有机尾气。两级吸收有利于提高净化效率，循环冷却可减小温升对吸收效果的影响。
装置可根据现场风量、入口浓度、排放指标和回收要求配置单塔、双塔或多级吸收形式，并可与精馏、冷凝、废水处理等后续单元组合。PLC控制可实现循环泵、补水、排液和液位等联锁运行。
适用范围
适用于化工、医药、涂布、清洗、电子材料、树脂生产等工序中含丙酮、异丙醇或其他高水溶性VOCs的尾气治理。对于浓度较高、具备回收价值的工况，可结合后续精馏或溶剂回收系统进一步资源化利用。
工程关注点
设计时应重点核算气液比、吸收液温度、循环量、入口浓度波动、富液排放周期和后续处理能力。若尾气中含有不溶性有机物、酸碱气体或颗粒物，应增加预处理或分段治理，避免影响吸收效率和设备寿命。
detailParagraphsEn: Acetone and isopropanol are highly hydrophilic VOCs and are suitable for water absorption when treating high- or medium-concentration tail gas. Collected gas first enters a pretreatment section to remove entrained droplets, dust or condensable impurities, reducing impact on tower packing and circulation equipment.

After pretreatment, organic tail gas passes through the first-stage and second-stage absorption towers and contacts circulating absorption water countercurrently. Acetone and isopropanol transfer from gas phase into liquid phase, while purified gas exits from the tower top and is discharged through the stack according to project emission requirements.

The circulating absorption liquid is delivered by pumps and cooled through a heat exchanger to control liquid temperature and maintain stable absorption performance. As organic concentration increases, the rich absorption liquid enters a storage tank and can be sent to recovery, rectification separation, or the plant wastewater/solvent recovery system.

The process is clear and the equipment structure is relatively simple. It is suitable for acetone, isopropanol and other highly water-soluble VOCs that can be transferred through liquid absorption. Two-stage absorption improves purification efficiency, and circulation cooling reduces the influence of temperature rise on absorption performance.

The unit can be configured as single-tower, two-tower or multi-stage absorption according to air volume, inlet concentration, emission target and recovery requirement. It can also be combined with rectification, condensation and wastewater treatment. PLC control can interlock circulation pumps, makeup water, drainage and liquid level.

The system is applicable to tail gas containing acetone, isopropanol or other highly water-soluble VOCs from chemical, pharmaceutical, coating, cleaning, electronic material and resin production processes. For higher concentration gas with recovery value, downstream rectification or solvent recovery can be added for resource utilization.

Design should focus on gas-liquid ratio, absorption liquid temperature, circulation rate, inlet concentration fluctuation, rich-liquid discharge cycle and downstream treatment capacity. If the gas contains insoluble organics, acid/alkaline gases or particles, pretreatment or segmented treatment should be added to protect absorption efficiency and equipment life.

products.title: 颗粒活性炭(GAC)吸附回收装置
products.category: 真空负压脱附尾气回收设备
products.summary: 颗粒活性炭（GAC）有机废气吸附回收装置由预处理系统、吸附系统、解吸系统、管路系统、冷凝回收系统等部分组成。
products.detail: 颗粒活性炭（GAC）有机废气吸附回收装置由预处理系统、吸附系统、解吸系统、管路系统、冷凝回收系统等部分组成。整个工艺流程如图所示，当A吸附罐吸附时，B吸附罐解吸，C吸附罐干燥。当有机尾（废）气进入吸附罐，其中的有机物穿过颗粒活性炭后被吸附下来，净化后的气体由吸附罐顶部排出。A、B、C三个吸附罐交替切换。系统采用低压蒸汽为脱附剂，脱附蒸汽由吸附罐底部进入，穿过颗粒活性炭，将被吸附浓缩的有机物脱附出来并带入冷凝统，经过冷凝，有机物和水蒸汽的混合物进入分层槽，通过重力沉降如原理分离，达到回收有机物的目的；如需处理的有机物溶于水或者客户方无法提供蒸汽来源，则采用真空脱附的解析工艺，回收物不与水接触，可以直接回收套用。系统运行过程中所有的动作切换均由自动控制系统完成。（注：根据工艺要求，可设计为单罐系统或双罐、多罐系统）适用范围GAC有机废气吸附回收装置可广泛应用于化工、石油化工、涂布、医药、农药、感光材料、橡胶、塑胶、人造革、涂装、罐装车、印刷等行业排放的大量有机气体的回收。适用范围：化工行业中各类有机化学品生产、药物生产及各类树脂生产工艺过程中的废气；汽车、摩托车、自行车行业金属件和塑料件的表面涂装废气；机械、船舶、家电、家具、建材等行业的金属件和塑料件的表面涂装废气；制鞋行业的“三苯”废气；印刷、印铁制罐行业的各类废气；电子、漆包线生产过程中的各类废气；沥青、橡胶制品生产过程中的各类废气；食品加工过程中产生的各类废气；其它恶臭性气体。
detailParagraphs: 工艺叙述

GAC有机废气吸附回收装置可广泛应用于化工、石油化工、涂布、医药、农药、感光材料、橡胶、塑胶、人造革、涂装、罐装车、印刷等行业排放的大量有机气体的回收。

products.title: 真空挡板阀
products.category: 非标定制设备及特殊大口径阀门
products.summary: 高真空挡板阀用于接通或切断真空管路中的气流，适用系列为 GD-J / GD-J(b) / GD-S。
products.detail: 高真空挡板阀用于接通或切断真空管路中的气流。高真空挡板阀按轴封结构可分GD-J型橡胶轴封和GD-J(b)型波纹管轴封两种。按通导形式可分GD-J为角通型式，GD-S为带预抽口的三通型式。阀体、阀盖、阀杆：铝合金、碳钢或不锈钢。密封件：丁腈橡胶、氟橡胶、波纹管（轴封）。适用范围：1×10-6Pa～1.2×105Pa（波纹管密封）；1×10-5Pa～1.2×105Pa（氟胶圈密封）。打开时阀板上的压差：≤1.2×105Pa，任意方向。阀体和阀座漏率：≤1.3×10-7Pa·L·s-1。建议首次维修前循环次数：200,000次。阀体烘烤温度：≤150℃。安装位置：手动驱动任意，气动驱动任意；电磁驱动任意（波纹管密封），密封面朝向真空（氟胶圈密封）。电源：气动驱动交流220V 50Hz 6W或直流24V 3W，特殊规格可定做；电磁驱动交流220V或230V 50Hz，起动功率800W、保持功率8W。压缩空气（只适用于气动）：0.4～0.7MPa。气动驱动≤1s；电磁驱动开启≤0.1s；关闭≤1s（氟胶圈密封）、关闭≤0.5s（波纹管密封）。阀门位置指示：手动驱动带有启闭位置指示；气动驱动带有启闭位置指示开关（磁性开关）；电磁驱动带有开启位置指示灯。
detailParagraphs: 产品说明
高真空挡板阀用于接通或切断真空管路中的气流。高真空挡板阀按轴封结构可分GD-J型橡胶轴封和GD-J(b)型波纹管轴封两种。按通导形式可分GD-J为角通型式，GD-S为带预抽口的三通型式。
主要零件材料
阀体、阀盖、阀杆：铝合金、碳钢或不锈钢。密封件：丁腈橡胶、氟橡胶、波纹管（轴封）。
主要性能指标
适用范围：1×10-6Pa～1.2×105Pa（波纹管密封）；1×10-5Pa～1.2×105Pa（氟胶圈密封）。打开时阀板上的压差：≤1.2×105Pa，任意方向。阀体和阀座漏率：≤1.3×10-7Pa·L·s-1。建议首次维修前循环次数：200,000次。阀体烘烤温度：≤150℃。
安装与驱动
安装位置：手动驱动任意，气动驱动任意；电磁驱动任意（波纹管密封），密封面朝向真空（氟胶圈密封）。电源：气动驱动交流220V 50Hz 6W或直流24V 3W，特殊规格可定做；电磁驱动交流220V或230V 50Hz，起动功率800W、保持功率8W。压缩空气（只适用于气动）：0.4～0.7MPa。
开启关闭时间
气动驱动≤1s；电磁驱动开启≤0.1s；关闭≤1s（氟胶圈密封）、关闭≤0.5s（波纹管密封）。阀门位置指示：手动驱动带有启闭位置指示；气动驱动带有启闭位置指示开关（磁性开关）；电磁驱动带有开启位置指示灯。

products.title: 有氧硫化氢制取单质硫设备
products.category: 有氧硫化氢制取单质硫设备
products.summary: 含H2S的尾气经二级Na2CO3处理后，经氧化塔氧化去掉有机物，水喷淋洗涤后排放，并实现单质硫回收。
products.detail: 含H2S的尾气经二级Na2CO3处理后经氧化塔氧化去掉有机物，水喷淋洗涤后排放。尾气从碱喷淋塔底部进入，经调配好一定浓度的NaCO3溶液从塔顶喷淋下来，经气液充分接触，生成NaHS溶液。NaHS溶液进入氧化塔氧化，在氧化塔中，加入PDF催化剂，鼓入空气，在催化剂的作用下，NaHS被氧化成单质硫，溶液中的Na+离子和CO32-离子重新生成NaCO3重新循环使用。生成的单质硫经过连续压滤、熔硫后生成较好品质的硫磺。工艺说明该工艺将含硫尾气治理与资源化回收结合，核心流程包括碱液吸收、氧化再生、硫浆沉降、连续压滤、熔硫与成品硫磺收集。
detailParagraphs: 工艺简述
含H2S的尾气经二级Na2CO3处理后经氧化塔氧化去掉有机物，水喷淋洗涤后排放。尾气从碱喷淋塔底部进入，经调配好一定浓度的NaCO3溶液从塔顶喷淋下来，经气液充分接触，生成NaHS溶液。
NaHS溶液进入氧化塔氧化，在氧化塔中，加入PDF催化剂，鼓入空气，在催化剂的作用下，NaHS被氧化成单质硫，溶液中的Na+离子和CO32-离子重新生成NaCO3重新循环使用。生成的单质硫经过连续压滤、熔硫后生成较好品质的硫磺。
工艺说明
该工艺将含硫尾气治理与资源化回收结合，核心流程包括碱液吸收、氧化再生、硫浆沉降、连续压滤、熔硫与成品硫磺收集。

technicalServices.title: 活性炭吸附真空负压脱附如何提升危废治理的安全性
technicalServices.summary: 在工业废气治理领域，传统的高温脱附技术曾长期占据主导地位，但其高温高压的操作环境具有不小的安全隐患。近年来，活性炭吸附真空负压脱附蒸汽辅热系统正在悄然改变这一局面。这一工艺不仅大幅提升了废气处理效率，更以多重安全保障机制
paragraphs: 在工业废气治理领域，传统的高温脱附技术曾长期占据主导地位，但其高温高压的操作环境具有不小的安全隐患。近年来，活性炭吸附真空负压脱附蒸汽辅热系统正在悄然改变这一局面。这一工艺不仅大幅提升了废气处理效率，更以多重安全保障机制重塑了行业安全标准，堪称一场无声的安全革命。
从 “开放”到“封闭”：隔绝空气中的风险
传统高温脱附系统如同一个周期性 “呼吸”的装置，不断与外界空气交换，这种“呼吸”正是安全隐患的根源。
真空脱附的革命性设计在于传统工艺必需的 “干燥阶段”被彻底取消，系统采用全密闭真空工艺进行脱附。在真空负压状态下，有机物分子在 70-80 ℃的低温下就能从活性炭孔隙中“跃出”，随即进入冷凝器回收。整个过程如同一个完全封闭的系统，外界空气被严格隔离。少量的不凝气则被重新引至设备前端再次吸附，实现系统内循环。蒸汽在此过程中只提高床层的温度。
彻底消除 “自燃温床”：真空的无死角优势
传统蒸汽脱附面临一个结构性问题，蒸汽在吸附罐内的分布难以绝对均匀，可能形成流动 “死角”。这些区域的有机物无法被有效脱附，在后续与空气接触时，残留的有机物会在高温下发生缓慢氧化，持续积累热量，引发安全隐患。
真空脱附从原理上解决了这一难题。当系统抽成真空时，负压环境会均匀作用于吸附罐的每个角落，如同为整个炭床施加了均匀的 “吸力”。这种均匀的负压环境确保了有机物分子能从所有活性炭孔隙中均匀脱出，不留死角。
实际运行数据表明，采用真空脱附的装置，其脱附彻底性比传统方法提高约 30% ，大大消除了因局部有机物积聚而引发的氧化放热风险。
低温运行：双重安全屏障
避免水煤气反应：在传统高温脱附环境中，如果系统存在微量水分，活性炭作为催化剂可能引发水煤气反应，产生易燃易爆的合成气。真空脱附将温度严格控制在 70-80 ℃，远低于水煤气反应通常需要的温度，彻底杜绝了这一风险。
低温操作带来了双重安全效益：避免热敏性物料在高温下分解、水解，不仅提高了回收物料的品质和价值，也防止了分解产物可能带来的腐蚀或二次污染。显著降低对活性炭本身的热损伤，使用寿命延长 50%-100% ，减少了因炭床性能衰减而带来的操作风险。
活性炭吸附真空负压脱附蒸汽辅热系统通过工艺本身的本质安全设计，在源头消除风险条件。对于需要处理易燃易爆有机废气的企业而言，这不仅是技术升级，更是安全管理的革命性进步。其也正成为高安全标准场景下的优选方案，为绿色生产筑起了一道更加可靠的安全防线。

technicalServices.titleEn: How Activated Carbon Adsorption and Vacuum Desorption Improve Hazardous-Waste Treatment Safety
technicalServices.customFlowTitleEn: Activated Carbon Adsorption and Vacuum Desorption Dynamic Process Flow
technicalServices.summaryEn: This article explains how activated carbon adsorption with vacuum negative-pressure desorption and steam-assisted heating improves treatment efficiency while reducing ignition, oxidation and high-temperature operating risks.
paragraphsEn: In industrial waste-gas treatment, conventional high-temperature desorption has long been widely used, but its high-temperature and high-pressure operating conditions may bring safety risks. Activated carbon adsorption with vacuum negative-pressure desorption and steam-assisted heating is changing this situation by improving treatment efficiency and adding multiple intrinsic safety safeguards.
From “Open” to “Closed”: Isolating Air-Related Risks
Traditional high-temperature desorption systems operate like equipment that periodically “breathes” with the outside environment. This exchange with air is one of the sources of safety risk.

The key change in vacuum desorption is that the drying stage required by traditional processes is removed. The system uses a fully sealed vacuum process. Under negative pressure, organic molecules can desorb from activated carbon pores at about 70-80 C and then enter the condenser for recovery. The whole process is sealed from outside air. A small amount of non-condensable gas is returned to the front of the unit for re-adsorption, forming internal circulation. Steam is used mainly to raise the bed temperature.
Eliminating the “Self-Ignition Bed”: Uniform Vacuum Desorption

Traditional steam desorption may face uneven steam distribution inside the adsorber, creating flow dead zones. Organics in these areas may not be fully desorbed and may slowly oxidize when later exposed to air, accumulating heat and increasing safety risks.

Vacuum desorption addresses this at the principle level. When the system is evacuated, negative pressure acts uniformly throughout the adsorber, applying a consistent extraction force to the carbon bed. This helps organics desorb evenly from all activated carbon pores with fewer dead zones.

Operating data show that vacuum desorption can improve desorption completeness by about 30% compared with traditional methods, reducing the risk of local organic accumulation and oxidation heat release.
Low-Temperature Operation: A Double Safety Barrier

Avoiding water-gas reaction: in traditional high-temperature desorption, trace moisture may react with activated carbon as a catalyst to generate flammable synthesis gas. Vacuum desorption keeps temperature at about 70-80 C, far below the typical temperature required for such reactions, helping eliminate this risk.

Low-temperature operation also helps prevent heat-sensitive materials from decomposition and hydrolysis, improving recovered-material quality and reducing corrosion or secondary pollution. It also reduces thermal damage to activated carbon, extending service life by 50%-100% and lowering operational risk caused by carbon-bed degradation.

Activated carbon adsorption with vacuum negative-pressure desorption and steam-assisted heating improves safety through intrinsic process design. For facilities handling flammable organic waste gas, it is both a technical upgrade and a safety-management improvement, providing a more reliable barrier for green production.

technicalServices.title: VOCs有机废气处理设备有哪些
technicalServices.summary: VOCs有机废气处理设备有哪些 VOCs有机废气处理设备主要被用来处理有机废气，这样所排放的气体机就不会对大气产生严重的影响。这种有机废气处理设备的应用领域比较多，为了更好的帮助人们进行空气净化工作，特别介绍有机废气处理
paragraphs: VOCs有机废气处理设备有哪些 VOCs有机废气处理设备主要被用来处理有机废气，这样所排放的气体机就不会对大气产生严重的影响。这种有机废气处理设备的应用领域比较多，为了更好的帮助人们进行空气净化工作，特别介绍有机废气处理设备所具有的特性、方法等。 有机废气处理设备在结构上设计比较优化，设备的结构强度比较高，人们对这种设备比较喜爱。 设备在运输的时候费用比较低，人们可以通过较少的投入，同时实现多种废气的净化工作。 有机废气处理设备是指用多种技术措施，通过不同途径减少损耗、减少有机溶剂用量或排气净化以消除有机废气污染。有机废气污染源分布广泛。 为防止污染，除减少石油损耗、减少有机溶剂用量以减少有机废气的产生和排放外，排气净化是目前切实可行的治理途径。 常用的方法有吸附法、吸收法、催化燃烧法、热力燃烧法、光催化氧化等。选用净化方法时，应根据具体情况由县选用费用低、耗能少、无二次污染的方法，尽量做到化害为利，充分回收利用成分 和余热。多数情况下，石油化工业因排气浓度高，采用冷凝、吸收、光催化氧化、直接燃烧等方法； 涂料施工、印刷等行业因排气浓度低，采用吸附、光催化氧化、催化燃烧等方法。 有机废气处理设备 1、冷凝回收法：把有机废气直接导入化工尾气回收装置吸附、吸收、“解板、分离，可回收有价值的有机物，该法适用于有机废气浓度高、温度低、风量小的工况，需要附属冷冻设备，主要应用于制药、化工行业，印刷。 2、吸收法：一般采用物理吸收，即将废气工业尾气吸收液进净化，待吸收液饱和后经加热、解析、冷凝回收；本法适用于大气量、低温度、低浓度的废气，但需配备加热解析回收装置，设备体积大、投资较高。 一般采用活性炭吸附法：通过活性炭吸附废气，当吸附饱和后，脱附再生，将废气吹脱后催化燃烧，转化为无害物质，再生后的活性炭继续使用。当活性炭再生到一定次数后，吸附容量明显下降，则需要再生或更新活性炭。 活性炭是目前处理有机废气使用最多的方法，对苯类废气具有良好的吸附性能，但对烃类废气吸附性较差。 3、直接燃烧法：利用燃气或燃油等辅助燃料燃烧，将混合气体加热，使有害物质在高温作用下 分解为无害物质；本法工艺简单、投资小，适用于高浓度、小风量的废气，但对安全技术较高。 4、催化燃烧法：把废气加热经催化燃烧转化成无害无臭的二氧化碳和水；本法起燃温度低、节能、净化率高、操作方便、占地面积少、投资投资较大，适用于高温或高浓度的有机废气。 5、吸附法： （1）直接吸附法：有机废气经活性炭吸附，可达95%以上的净化率，设备简单、投资小，但活性炭更换频繁，增加了装卸、运输、更换等工作程序，导致运行费用增加。 （2）吸附-回收法：利用纤维活性炭吸附有机废气，在接近饱和后用过热水蒸汽反吹，进行脱附再生；本法要求提供必要的蒸汽量。 6、光催化氧化： 是运行了半个世纪的一种废气治理方法，得到国家环保部推荐的一种方法。综合了吸附法、催化燃烧法、低温等离子体的优点，采用新型催化剂材料，大大降低能耗。本法具有运行稳定可靠、投资省、运行成本低、维修方便等特点，适用于大风量、低浓度的废气治理，是目前国内治理有机废气处理较成熟、实用的方法。 应用领域：化工、油品、石油化工、制药、农药、汽车部件、涂装、电气、电子元件、印刷、电镀、罐装车、橡胶、感光材料、纤维、塑胶、人造革、污水厂、污水站等行业。
methodIntro: VOCs有机废气处理设备主要用于处理有机废气，降低排放对大气环境的影响。常用治理路线包括冷凝回收、吸收、燃烧、催化燃烧、吸附净化、吸附回收以及光催化氧化等。
选用净化方法时，应结合废气浓度、温度、风量、回收价值、安全要求和运行成本，尽量做到化害为利，充分回收有价值成分和余热。

methodSections.title: 冷凝回收法
methodSections.text: 把有机废气导入化工尾气回收装置，通过预处理、冷凝、吸附/吸收、解吸分离等单元回收有价值有机物。该法适用于有机废气浓度高、温度低、风量小的工况，通常需要配置冷冻设备，主要应用于制药、化工、印刷等行业。

methodSections.title: 吸收法
methodSections.text: 一般采用物理吸收，即将废气与吸收液接触净化，待吸收液饱和后经加热、解析、冷凝回收。本法适用于大气量、低温度、低浓度废气，但需配备加热解析回收装置，设备体积和投资相对较高。

methodSections.title: 直接燃烧法
methodSections.text: 利用燃气或燃油等辅助燃料燃烧，将混合气体加热，使有害物质在高温作用下分解为无害物质。本法工艺简单、投资小，适用于高浓度、小风量有机废气，但对安全技术要求较高。

methodSections.title: 催化燃烧法
methodSections.text: 把废气加热后经催化燃烧转化为无害、无臭的二氧化碳和水。本法起燃温度低、节能、净化率高、操作方便、占地面积少，适用于高温或高浓度有机废气治理。

methodSections.title: 吸附法（直接吸附法）
methodSections.text: 有机废气经活性炭直接吸附，可达到较高净化率，设备简单、投资小。但活性炭更换频繁，会增加装卸、运输、更换等工作程序，运行费用相对较高。

methodSections.title: 吸附-回收法
methodSections.text: 利用纤维活性炭吸附有机废气，在接近饱和后采用过热水蒸汽或有机蒸汽反吹进行脱附再生，再通过冷凝分离回收有机物。本法适用于需要吸附净化并回收有机物的场景，但需提供必要蒸汽量。

methodSections.title: 光催化氧化法
methodSections.text: 综合吸附法、催化燃烧法及低温等离子体等工艺优点，采用新型催化剂材料，在紫外光和催化剂作用下氧化分解有机污染物。本法能耗低、运行稳定、投资省、维护方便，适用于大风量、低浓度有机废气治理。

technicalServices.methodFooter: 应用领域：化工、油品、石油化工、制药、农药、汽车部件、涂装、电气、电子元件、印刷、电镀、罐装车、橡胶、感光材料、纤维、塑胶、人造革、污水厂、污水站等行业。
technicalServices.titleEn: What Types of VOC Organic Waste Gas Treatment Equipment Are Available?
technicalServices.summaryEn: This article summarizes common VOC organic waste gas treatment routes, including condensation recovery, absorption, combustion, catalytic combustion, adsorption, adsorption recovery and photocatalytic oxidation.
methodIntroEn: VOC organic waste gas treatment equipment is used to reduce the impact of organic exhaust emissions on the atmosphere. Common treatment routes include condensation recovery, absorption, combustion, catalytic combustion, adsorption purification, adsorption recovery and photocatalytic oxidation.

The proper process should be selected according to gas concentration, temperature, air volume, recovery value, safety requirements and operating cost, with the goal of reducing hazards and recovering valuable components whenever possible.

methodSectionsEn.title: Condensation Recovery
methodSectionsEn.text: Organic waste gas is introduced into a chemical tail-gas recovery unit. Through pretreatment, condensation, adsorption or absorption, desorption and separation, valuable organics can be recovered. This method is suitable for high-concentration, low-temperature and low-flow conditions and usually requires refrigeration equipment. It is commonly used in pharmaceutical, chemical and printing industries.

methodSectionsEn.title: Absorption
methodSectionsEn.text: Physical absorption brings waste gas into contact with an absorbent liquid. After saturation, the absorbent is heated, stripped and condensed for recovery. It is suitable for large air volume, low-temperature and low-concentration gas, but requires heating and stripping equipment, so the unit is larger and investment is higher.

methodSectionsEn.title: Direct Combustion
methodSectionsEn.text: Auxiliary fuel such as gas or oil is used to heat the mixed gas so harmful substances decompose at high temperature. The process is simple and investment is relatively low. It is suitable for high-concentration and low-flow organic waste gas, but has higher safety requirements.

methodSectionsEn.title: Catalytic Combustion
methodSectionsEn.text: Waste gas is heated and converted by catalytic combustion into harmless carbon dioxide and water. This method has a lower ignition temperature, saves energy, offers high purification efficiency and is convenient to operate. It is suitable for high-temperature or high-concentration organic waste gas.

methodSectionsEn.title: Adsorption: Direct Adsorption
methodSectionsEn.text: Organic waste gas is directly adsorbed by activated carbon and can achieve high purification efficiency. The equipment is simple and investment is low, but frequent activated carbon replacement increases loading, transport, replacement and operating costs.

methodSectionsEn.title: Adsorption-Recovery
methodSectionsEn.text: Activated carbon fiber adsorbs organic waste gas. When near saturation, superheated steam or organic vapor is used for desorption and regeneration, followed by condensation and separation to recover organics. It is suitable when both purification and recovery are required, but a stable steam supply is needed.

methodSectionsEn.title: Photocatalytic Oxidation
methodSectionsEn.text: This route combines advantages of adsorption, catalytic combustion and low-temperature plasma. With UV light and catalysts, organic pollutants are oxidized and decomposed. It features low energy consumption, stable operation, lower investment and easy maintenance, and is suitable for large-volume, low-concentration VOC treatment.

technicalServices.methodFooterEn: Applications: chemical, oil products, petrochemical, pharmaceutical, pesticide, automotive parts, coating, electrical and electronic components, printing, electroplating, tank loading, rubber, photosensitive materials, fiber, plastics, artificial leather, wastewater plants and related industries.

technicalServices.title: 风机日常维护
technicalServices.summary: 风机是一种将原动机的机械能转换为输送气体、给予气体能量的机械，它是火电厂中不可少的机械设备，主要有送风机、引风机、一次风机、密封风机和排粉机等，消耗电能约占发电厂发电量的1．5%～3．0%。在火电厂的实际运行中，风机，特
paragraphs: 风机是一种将原动机的机械能转换为输送气体、给予气体能量的机械，是火电厂中不可少的机械设备，主要有送风机、引风机、一次风机、密封风机和排粉机等，消耗电能约占发电厂发电量的1.5%～3.0%。
在火电厂的实际运行中，风机，特别是引风机由于运行条件较恶劣，故障率较高。据有关统计资料，引风机平均每年发生故障为2次，送风机平均每年发生故障为0.4次，从而导致机组非计划停运或减负荷运行。因此，迅速判断风机运行中故障产生的原因，并采取得力措施解决，是发电厂连续安全运行的保障。
虽然风机的故障类型繁多，原因也很复杂，但根据调查，电厂实际运行中风机故障较多的是：轴承振动、轴承温度高、动叶卡涩、保护装置误动。
风机轴承振动超标
风机轴承振动是运行中常见的故障。风机振动会引起轴承和叶片损坏、螺栓松动、机壳和风道损坏等问题，严重危及风机的安全运行。风机轴承振动超标的原因较多，如能针对不同现象分析原因并采取恰当处理办法，往往能起到事半功倍的效果。
不停炉处理叶片非工作面积灰引起风机振动
这类缺陷常见于锅炉引风机，现象主要表现为风机在运行中振动突然上升。这是因为当气体进入叶轮时，与旋转叶片工作面存在一定角度，根据流体力学原理，气体在叶片非工作面会产生旋涡，气体中的灰粒会因旋涡作用慢慢沉积在非工作面上。机翼型叶片最易积灰。
当积灰达到一定重量时，由于叶轮旋转离心力的作用，部分大块积灰会被甩出叶轮。由于各叶片上的积灰不可能完全均匀一致，聚集或甩落的时间也不一定同步，结果会因叶片积灰不均匀导致叶轮质量分布不平衡，从而使风机振动增大。
通常情况下，只需把叶片上的积灰铲除，叶轮即可重新达到平衡，从而减少风机振动。在实际工作中，常规处理方法是临时停炉后打开风机机壳人孔门，检修人员进入机壳内清除叶轮积灰。这样不仅环境恶劣、存在不安全因素，也会造成机组非计划停运，检修时间长，劳动强度大。
经过研究，可采用一种经实际证明有效的处理方法：在机壳喉舌处径向对着叶轮加装一排喷嘴（4～5个），将喷嘴调成不同角度。喷嘴与冲灰水泵相连，以冲灰水作为冲洗积灰的动力介质，降低负荷后停单侧风机，在停风机瞬间迅速打开阀门，利用叶轮惯性喷洗叶片非工作面，并打开机壳底部加装的阀门排走冲灰水。这样可实现不停炉处理风机振动。
用冲灰水作清灰介质，与蒸汽和压缩空气相比，具有对喷嘴结构要求低、清灰范围大、效果好、对叶片磨损小等优点。
不停炉处理叶片磨损引起的振动
磨损是风机中最常见的现象。风机在运行中振动缓慢上升，一般是由于叶片磨损、平衡破坏后造成的。此时处理风机振动的问题，通常是在停炉后做动平衡。根据风机特点，经过多次实践，可在不停炉情况下对风机进行动平衡试验。
处理步骤包括：在机壳喉舌径向对着叶轮处加装一个手孔门，此处离叶轮外圆边缘距离最近，约200mm多，人站在风机外面即可进行内部操作；风机正常运行时手孔门关闭；振动发生后将单侧风机停下，打开手孔门，在机壳外对叶轮进行试加重量；找完平衡后，计算应加重量和位置，对叶轮进行焊接。
实际工作中，用三点法找动平衡较为简单方便。试加重量的计算公式为：P≤250×A0×G/D（3000/n）²（g）。为了尽快找到应加重量和位置，应根据平时数据多总结经验。
根据经验，Y4-73-11-22D风机振动0.10mm时，不平衡重量约为2000g；M5-29-11-18D排粉机振动0.10mm时，不平衡重量约为120g；轴流ASN2125/1250型引风机振动0.10mm时，不平衡重量约为80g左右。
为了达到不停炉处理叶片磨损引起振动问题的目的，平时须加强对风门挡板的维护，减少风门挡板漏风。在单侧风机停运时，应防止热风从停运送风机处漏出，以维持良好的工作环境。
technicalServices.titleEn: Daily Maintenance of Fans
technicalServices.summaryEn: This article summarizes common fan faults and maintenance approaches, especially bearing vibration caused by blade ash accumulation or wear.
paragraphsEn: Fans are machines that convert the mechanical energy of a prime mover into gas conveying energy. They are essential in power plants, including forced-draft fans, induced-draft fans, primary air fans, seal-air fans and pulverized-coal exhausters. Their power consumption usually accounts for about 1.5%-3.0% of plant generation.

In actual operation, induced-draft fans often work under harsh conditions and have relatively high fault rates. Rapidly identifying fault causes and taking effective measures is important for continuous and safe plant operation.
Although fan faults are varied and complex, common issues include bearing vibration, high bearing temperature, blade sticking and protection-device malfunctions.
Excessive Fan Bearing Vibration

Bearing vibration is a common operating fault. It can damage bearings and blades, loosen bolts, damage casing and ducts, and threaten safe operation. Different symptoms should be analyzed to select the proper treatment method.
Handling Vibration Caused by Ash Accumulation Without Boiler Shutdown

This fault is common in boiler induced-draft fans and often appears as a sudden vibration increase. Dust may accumulate on the non-working side of blades due to vortices. When accumulated ash is unevenly distributed or partly thrown off by centrifugal force, rotor mass balance is disturbed and vibration increases.

Normally, removing blade deposits can restore balance. However, conventional treatment requires temporary boiler shutdown and manual cleaning inside the fan casing, which is labor-intensive and has safety risks.

An effective method is to install several nozzles at the casing throat facing the impeller. Flushing water is used as the cleaning medium. After reducing load and stopping one fan, the valve is opened quickly so the remaining impeller inertia helps wash the non-working blade surfaces, and wastewater is discharged from the bottom valve.
Compared with steam or compressed air, flushing water requires simpler nozzle structure, has wider cleaning coverage, better effect and less blade wear.
Handling Vibration Caused by Blade Wear Without Boiler Shutdown

Blade wear is common. Slowly increasing vibration is usually caused by wear-related imbalance. Dynamic balancing is often performed after shutdown, but practical methods can allow balancing tests without full boiler shutdown.

A hand hole can be installed at the casing throat facing the impeller. When vibration occurs, stop one fan, open the hand hole and add trial weights from outside the casing. After balancing, calculate the required weight and position and weld it to the impeller.
The three-point method is relatively simple for dynamic balancing. Trial weight can be estimated by P <= 250 x A0 x G / D x (3000 / n)^2 (g). Historical data should be used to improve accuracy.

For example, when vibration is 0.10 mm, typical unbalance weight may be about 2000 g for a Y4-73-11-22D fan, about 120 g for an M5-29-11-18D pulverized-coal fan, and about 80 g for an ASN2125/1250 axial induced-draft fan.
To make this approach practical, damper maintenance should be strengthened to reduce air leakage and maintain a safe working environment when one fan is stopped.

technicalServices.title: 干式螺杆真空泵工作原理
technicalServices.summary: 螺杆式干式真空泵的工作过程可分为吸气、压缩和排气三个过程。随着转子的旋转，每对相互啮合的齿相继完成相同的工作循环，现在以其中一对齿来说明。阳转子按逆时针方向旋转，阴螺杆按顺时针方向旋转。图中上方的转子端面是吸气断面，下方
paragraphs: 螺杆式干式真空泵的工作循环可分为吸气、压缩和排气三个过程。随着阴、阳转子相互啮合旋转，每对齿间容积依次完成吸入、封闭输送、压缩和排出。
吸气过程
随着转子转动，齿间容积逐渐展开并与吸气口相通，气体被吸入泵腔。图中上方的转子端面为吸气断面，下方端面为排气端面。
压缩过程
吸入气体被封闭在齿槽容积内，并沿轴向输送。随着齿间容积逐渐缩小，气体被逐步压缩，压力随之升高。
排气过程
当齿间容积与排气孔口连通后，即开始排气。随着容积继续缩小，具有排气压力的气体逐渐通过排气孔口被排出。
整体结构与维护关注
阳转子与阴转子旋向相反，依靠精密啮合完成气体输送。
泵腔内不需要工作液参与，适用于对洁净真空和低污染排放要求较高的场景。
运行维护中应重点关注转子间隙、轴承状态、冷却条件和排气温升。

technicalServices.titleEn: Working Principle of a Dry Screw Vacuum Pump
technicalServices.summaryEn: This article explains the three-stage working cycle of a dry screw vacuum pump: suction, compression and discharge.
technicalServices.principleIntroEn: The working cycle of a dry screw vacuum pump can be divided into suction, compression and discharge. As the male and female rotors mesh and rotate, each enclosed tooth-space volume completes gas intake, sealed conveying, compression and discharge in sequence.

principleStepsEn.title: Suction Process
principleStepsEn.text: As the rotors turn, the tooth-space volume gradually opens and connects with the suction port, allowing gas to enter the pump chamber. The upper rotor end face is the suction side and the lower end face is the discharge side.

principleStepsEn.title: Compression Process
principleStepsEn.text: The intake gas is enclosed in the tooth-space volume and conveyed axially. As the volume gradually decreases, the gas is compressed and pressure rises.

principleStepsEn.title: Discharge Process
principleStepsEn.text: When the tooth-space volume connects with the discharge port, discharge begins. As the volume continues to shrink, pressurized gas is pushed out through the discharge port.

principleNotesEn: The male and female rotors rotate in opposite directions and rely on precise meshing to convey gas.
No working liquid is required inside the pump chamber, making it suitable for clean vacuum and low-contamination exhaust requirements.
Maintenance should focus on rotor clearance, bearing condition, cooling conditions and discharge temperature rise.

technicalServices.title: 气动执行器安装维护
technicalServices.summary: 1、气动执行器与 阀门 连接符合iso5211标准，可与阀门直接连接。也可通过过渡 支架 和 接头 与任何阀门连接。2、安装时必须保证气动执行器和旋转轴与阀门轴的同轴度。 3、管接头及 导管 内部应 清洗 干净，无多余物
paragraphs: 安装连接
气动执行器与阀门连接应符合 ISO 5211 标准，可与阀门直接连接，也可通过过渡支架和接头与不同类型阀门连接。
安装时必须保证气动执行器旋转轴与阀门轴保持同轴，避免因偏心安装造成启闭不顺、密封磨损或传动部件受力异常。
管路清洁
管接头及导管内部应清洗干净，不得残留多余物、粉尘、油污等杂质，以免影响气路通畅和执行器动作稳定性。
附件连接
气动执行器与电磁阀、定位器、过滤器、减压阀等附件连接时，可采用铜管或尼龙管。为防尘并减少排气噪声，排气口宜安装消声器或消声节流阀。
气动执行器上的调节螺钉可用于微量调整阀门开启角度，调整完成后必须将螺帽锁紧，防止运行中松动。
调试试验
安装完成后，气动执行器与阀门应同时进行试验。阀门加压至额定压力后，以 0.4～0.7MPa 气源压力对气动执行器两个进气口进行切换进气，观察阀门开启和关闭情况，要求转动灵活、无卡阻，并进行反复试验。
安装电磁阀的气动执行器，调试时应先使用电磁阀上的手动装置进行调试，然后再通电调试。
定期维护
气动执行器应定期维护和保养，定期对配套使用的空气过滤器进行放水、排污。正常情况下，建议六个月检验一次，每年检修一次。
technicalServices.titleEn: Pneumatic Actuator Installation and Maintenance
technicalServices.summaryEn: Installation, commissioning and routine maintenance points for pneumatic actuators.
paragraphsEn: Installation Connection
The pneumatic actuator and valve connection should comply with ISO 5211. It can be connected directly to the valve or connected to different valves through transition brackets and couplings.
During installation, the actuator rotating shaft and valve shaft must remain coaxial to avoid poor opening/closing, seal wear or abnormal load on transmission parts.
Pipeline Cleaning
Pipe joints and internal guide tubes should be cleaned thoroughly. No debris, dust or oil should remain, otherwise air-path flow and actuator stability may be affected.
Accessory Connection

When connecting solenoid valves, positioners, filters and pressure reducing valves, copper or nylon tubes may be used. A silencer or exhaust throttle silencer should be installed at the exhaust port to reduce dust entry and noise.
The adjustment screw on the actuator can be used for fine adjustment of valve opening angle. After adjustment, the nut must be locked to prevent loosening during operation.
Commissioning Test

After installation, the actuator and valve should be tested together. Pressurize the valve to rated pressure, switch air supply to both actuator ports at 0.4-0.7 MPa, and confirm flexible opening and closing without jamming. Repeat the test several times.
For actuators with solenoid valves, commissioning should first be performed using the manual device on the solenoid valve, then repeated with power on.
Routine Maintenance
Pneumatic actuators should be maintained regularly. Drain and clean the matching air filter periodically. Under normal conditions, inspect every six months and overhaul once a year.

technicalServices.title: 离心泵不出水的原因及使用事项
technicalServices.summary: 离心泵不出水的原因 （1）水泵启动前未灌满足够的水，有时看上去灌的水已从放气孔溢出，但未转动泵轴交空气完全排出，致使少许空气残留在进水管或泵体中。 （2）与水泵接触的进水管的水平段逆水流方向应用0.5%以上的下降坡度，连
paragraphs: 离心泵不出水的原因
水泵启动前未灌满足够的水。有时看上去灌的水已从放气孔溢出，但未转动泵轴将空气完全排出，导致少量空气残留在进水管或泵体中。
与水泵接触的进水管水平段，应逆水流方向保持 0.5% 以上的下降坡度，连接水泵进口的一端为最高点，不宜完全水平。如果进水管向上翘起，管内会存留空气，降低水管和水泵中的真空度，影响吸水。
水泵填料因长期使用已经磨损，或填料压得过松，会造成大量水从填料与泵轴轴套的间隙中喷出，外部空气也会从这些间隙进入水泵内部，影响提水。
进水管长期潜在水下，管壁腐蚀后可能出现孔洞。水泵工作后水面不断下降，当这些孔洞露出水面后，空气会从孔洞进入进水管。
进水管弯管处出现裂痕，或进水管与水泵连接处存在微小间隙，也可能使空气进入进水管，造成离心泵不出水。
离心泵操作时的注意事项
禁止无水运行，不要通过调节吸入口来降低排量，也禁止在过低流量下运行。
运行过程中应重点监控，彻底阻止填料箱泄漏；更换填料箱时应使用新填料。
应确保机械密封有充分的冲洗水流；水冷轴承禁止使用过量水流。
润滑剂不宜使用过多，应按设备要求适量添加。
按推荐周期进行检查，并建立运行记录，包括运行小时数、填料调整与更换、润滑剂添加以及其他维护措施和时间。
对离心泵的抽吸压力、排放压力、流量、输入功率、洗液温度、轴承温度和振动情况，应定期测量并记录。
离心泵主机依靠大气压将低处的水抽到高处，而大气压最多只能支持约 10.3m 的水柱，因此离心泵主机离开水面 12m 时无法正常工作。
technicalServices.titleEn: Reasons Why a Centrifugal Pump Does Not Deliver Water and Operating Notes
technicalServices.summaryEn: Common causes of centrifugal pump no-flow problems and key operating precautions.
paragraphsEn: Reasons Why a Centrifugal Pump Does Not Deliver Water
Insufficient priming before startup. Sometimes water appears to overflow from the vent hole, but the pump shaft has not been rotated to fully expel air, leaving air in the inlet pipe or pump body.

The horizontal section of the inlet pipe connected to the pump should have a downward slope of more than 0.5% opposite the water-flow direction, with the pump-inlet end as the highest point. If the pipe tilts upward, air remains inside and reduces vacuum, affecting suction.
Packing may be worn after long service or pressed too loosely, causing water to spray from the gap between packing and shaft sleeve. External air then enters the pump and affects water lifting.
Long-submerged inlet pipes may corrode and develop holes. As the water level drops during operation, exposed holes allow air to enter the inlet pipe.
Cracks in inlet-pipe bends or small gaps at the pump connection can also allow air to enter, causing no water delivery.
Operating Notes for Centrifugal Pumps
Do not run without water. Do not reduce flow by throttling the suction inlet, and do not operate at excessively low flow.
Monitor operation carefully and prevent packing-box leakage. Use new packing when replacing it.
Ensure sufficient flushing water for the mechanical seal. Do not use excessive water flow for water-cooled bearings.
Do not overuse lubricant. Add lubricant according to equipment requirements.
Inspect according to the recommended schedule and keep operation records, including running hours, packing adjustment/replacement, lubricant addition and maintenance actions.
Regularly measure and record suction pressure, discharge pressure, flow, input power, liquid temperature, bearing temperature and vibration.

A centrifugal pump relies on atmospheric pressure to lift water. Atmospheric pressure supports only about 10.3 m of water column, so a pump placed 12 m above the water surface cannot operate normally.

technicalServices.title: 阀门与离心泵安全操作
technicalServices.summary: 概述 泵是流体工业的核心装置，其作用犹如人体的心脏，为系统中各装置内的流体提供动力，确保工艺流程正常运转。常用的泵，按大类分有叶片泵、容积泵、特殊用途泵等。其中，叶片泵中的离心泵应用最为广泛。 离心泵运行过程中需要避免两
paragraphs: 概述
泵是流体工业的核心装置，其作用犹如人体的心脏，为系统中各装置内的流体提供动力，确保工艺流程正常运转。常用泵按大类可分为叶片泵、容积泵、特殊用途泵等，其中叶片泵中的离心泵应用最为广泛。
离心泵运行过程中需要避免两个问题：停泵水锤和低于最小流量。解决这两类问题的方法较多，但基本思路都是围绕离心泵配置一套合适的系统。在这些系统中，阀门起着非常重要的作用，也因此形成了许多专用阀门。
停泵水锤保护与阀门
水锤是压力管道中介质流速剧烈变化引起的一系列急剧压力交替升降现象。水锤危害很大，可能击毁泵、管路以及其他设备。压力管道中的水锤产生原因很多，例如阀门快速关闭、非正常停泵等。
停泵水锤产生机理
当因断电等非正常原因导致泵突然停止工作时，初始阶段管道内介质会依靠惯性继续前进，但速度逐渐降为零。如果管道布置存在高低落差，介质会在重力作用下向泵倒流。
当倒流介质达到一定速度时，泵出口处止回阀会迅速关闭，大量介质速度突然变为零，引起该处介质压力急剧升高，从而产生停泵水锤。多数情况下，为防止大量介质倒流进入离心泵，泵出口处的防倒流设置仍是必要的。
停泵水锤避免措施
避免停泵水锤危害的措施有很多，例如安装水锤消除器、泄压阀、调压罐等。以下介绍两种与通用阀门相关、应用较多的措施。
设置缓闭止回阀
缓闭止回阀是一种通过增加执行机构、阻尼器而实现缓慢关闭的止回阀。介质在重力作用下倒流时，止回阀缓慢关闭，可有效避免普通止回阀突然关闭产生水锤。其缺点是关闭速度较慢，部分介质不可避免地倒流进入离心泵，可能造成泵的机械故障。
设置缓闭止回蝶阀
缓闭止回蝶阀在大型水利系统中应用较普遍，效果较好。它由蝶阀、执行机构及液压控制系统构成，既能起到止回阀作用，也能起到开关阀作用。离心泵开启时按先慢后快开启，保证泵低载开启；泵突然停止时按先快后慢关闭，既可避免水锤，也可减少介质倒流通过泵。
避免最小流量工况和阀门
最小流量是指保证泵能正常工作的流量。如果泵在低于最小流量工况下运行，会引起噪声和振动，泵性能变得不稳定，甚至导致非正常汽蚀，降低使用寿命。
目前较普遍的做法是为离心泵设置最小流量回路。但从泵本身价值来看，通常只有大流量、高扬程、大功率的离心泵设置最小流量回路才更合理。离心泵允许的最小流量值由泵制造商计算或试验确定。
最简单的最小流量回路只需在回路中安装一台开关阀，例如闸阀。当认为泵即将处于最小流量工况时，打开阀门接通最小流量回路，避免泵在最小流量工况下工作。
总结
以上介绍的阀门基本结构与通用阀门无异，但由于针对应用工况进行了相应改进，使这些阀门成为解决停泵水锤和最小流量问题的专用阀门。
technicalServices.titleEn: Safe Operation of Valves and Centrifugal Pumps
technicalServices.summaryEn: Key operating risks for centrifugal pumps, including pump-trip water hammer and minimum-flow operation, and valve-based protection measures.
paragraphsEn: Overview

Pumps are core devices in fluid systems, providing power for fluid movement. Common pumps include vane pumps, positive-displacement pumps and special-purpose pumps. Centrifugal pumps are the most widely used vane pumps.

Two issues should be avoided during centrifugal pump operation: pump-trip water hammer and operation below minimum flow. Many solutions are based on configuring a proper system around the pump, in which valves play an important role.
Pump-Trip Water Hammer Protection and Valves

Water hammer is a series of sudden pressure rises and drops caused by rapid changes in flow velocity in pressure pipelines. It can damage pumps, pipelines and other equipment. Causes include rapid valve closure and abnormal pump shutdown.
Mechanism of Pump-Trip Water Hammer

When a pump stops suddenly because of power failure or another abnormal cause, the medium continues moving by inertia and then slows to zero. If the pipeline has elevation difference, the medium flows backward under gravity.

When reverse flow reaches a certain speed, the check valve at the pump outlet closes quickly. The velocity of a large amount of medium suddenly becomes zero, causing a sharp pressure rise and water hammer. In most cases, an anti-backflow device at the pump outlet remains necessary.
Water Hammer Prevention Measures
Measures include water-hammer eliminators, relief valves and surge tanks. Two common valve-related measures are introduced below.
Slow-Closing Check Valve

A slow-closing check valve closes slowly by adding an actuator or damper. When reverse flow occurs, it can reduce water hammer caused by sudden check-valve closure. Its disadvantage is that some medium may flow back into the pump and cause mechanical problems.
Slow-Closing Check Butterfly Valve

This valve is widely used in large water systems. It combines the functions of a check valve and an on-off valve. During pump start it opens slowly then quickly; during sudden stop it closes quickly then slowly, reducing both water hammer and excessive reverse flow through the pump.
Avoiding Minimum-Flow Operation
Minimum flow is the flow required for stable pump operation. Operation below this value can cause noise, vibration, unstable performance and cavitation, reducing service life.
A minimum-flow bypass is commonly used. It is most reasonable for high-flow, high-head and high-power centrifugal pumps. The allowable minimum flow is calculated or tested by the pump manufacturer.
The simplest bypass uses an on-off valve such as a gate valve. When the pump approaches minimum-flow operation, the valve opens to connect the bypass and protect the pump.
Conclusion
These valves are structurally similar to general valves, but are modified for specific operating conditions and become special valves for solving water hammer and minimum-flow problems.

technicalServices.title: 阀门的腐蚀及解决的有效方法
technicalServices.summary: 1、阀门的腐蚀，通常被理解为阀门金属材料在化学的或电化学的环境作用下所受到的破坏。由于腐蚀现象出现于金属与周围环境自发的相互作用当中，因此，怎样将金属与周围环境相隔绝或更多的使用非金属合成材料，则成为人们普通关注的问题。
paragraphs: 阀门腐蚀的基本认识
阀门腐蚀通常指阀门金属材料在化学或电化学环境作用下受到破坏。由于腐蚀发生在金属与周围环境的自发相互作用中，因此，如何将金属与环境隔绝，或更多采用非金属合成材料，是阀门防腐的重要方向。
腐蚀对阀门寿命的影响
金属腐蚀会明显影响阀门的作用期限、可靠性和使用寿命。机械作用与腐蚀因素会共同增加接触表面的磨损量。阀门操作过程中，摩擦表面会因机械作用以及金属与环境之间的化学或电化学作用而产生磨损和破坏。
阀门管道工作条件往往较复杂。石油、天然气和油层水等介质中可能含有硫化氢、二氧化碳和某些有机酸，这些物质会增强对金属表面的破坏力，使阀门迅速失去工作能力。
影响腐蚀的因素
金属化学腐蚀与温度、摩擦零件的机械负荷、润滑材料中硫化物含量及抗酸稳定性、介质接触时间、金属对氮化过程的催化作用、腐蚀性分子对金属的转换速度等因素有关。
因此，金属阀门防腐措施以及合成材料阀门的应用，成为阀门行业的重要研究方向之一。
金属阀门防腐的理解
金属阀门防腐可理解为在金属阀门上涂覆保护层，例如漆、颜料、润滑材料等，使阀门在制造、保存、运输以及使用全过程中减少或避免腐蚀。
防腐方法的选择依据
金属阀门防腐方法取决于所需保护期限、运输和保存条件、阀门结构特点和材料，同时也应考虑防腐处理的经济效果。
常用防腐方法
将易挥发的腐蚀抑制剂放入蒸汽大气中，例如用阻化纸包裹，或吹动抑制空气通过制品腔室。
利用被阻化的水和酒精溶液进行防腐处理。
将防腐保护材料薄层涂覆于阀门及其零部件表面。
将被阻化的薄膜或聚合物薄层涂覆于阀门及其零部件表面。
technicalServices.titleEn: Valve Corrosion and Effective Solutions
technicalServices.summaryEn: Causes and prevention methods for corrosion of metal valves and valve components.
paragraphsEn: Basic Understanding of Valve Corrosion

Valve corrosion usually means damage to metal valve materials caused by chemical or electrochemical action. Because corrosion occurs through interaction between metal and the surrounding environment, isolating metal from the environment or using non-metallic synthetic materials is an important direction.
Impact on Valve Service Life

Corrosion reduces service life, reliability and usable life. Mechanical action and corrosion together increase wear on contact surfaces. During operation, friction surfaces may wear or fail under both mechanical action and chemical or electrochemical interaction.

Valve pipeline conditions are often complex. Media such as oil, natural gas and formation water may contain hydrogen sulfide, carbon dioxide and organic acids, increasing metal surface damage and causing rapid loss of function.
Factors Affecting Corrosion
Chemical corrosion is related to temperature, mechanical load, sulfides in lubricants, acid resistance, contact time, metal catalytic behavior and molecular conversion speed of corrosive substances.
Therefore, corrosion protection for metal valves and the use of synthetic-material valves are important topics in the valve industry.
Understanding Metal Valve Protection
Metal valve corrosion protection can be understood as applying a protective layer such as paint, pigment or lubricant to prevent corrosion during manufacturing, storage, transportation and use.
Selection Basis
The method depends on required protection duration, transportation and storage conditions, valve structure and materials, as well as economic considerations.
Common Protection Methods
Place volatile corrosion inhibitors in vapor atmosphere, such as wrapping with inhibitor paper or blowing inhibited air through product cavities.
Use inhibited water and alcohol solutions for protection.
Apply a thin layer of anti-corrosion protective material to valve and component surfaces.
Apply inhibited film or polymer coating to valve and component surfaces.

technicalServices.title: 真空阀门和常压高压阀门的普通区别
technicalServices.summary: 真空阀门和常压高压阀门的普通区别 真空阀门是指阀门内腔为真空状态，通常叫负压，内腔压力低于大气压，用于真空管道系统的阀门，有真空球阀，真空蝶阀，真空隔膜阀等。介质为高纯度。 通常情况下外漏是阀门的主要通病，也就是说大气环
paragraphs: 基本区别
真空阀门是指阀门内腔处于真空状态，通常称为负压，即内腔压力低于大气压，主要用于真空管道系统。常见类型包括真空球阀、真空蝶阀、真空隔膜阀等，介质通常要求较高纯度。
常压阀门和高压阀门是指阀门内腔压力大于环境压力，即大于大气压。此类阀门发生泄漏时，介质会通过泄漏部位排向外部环境，可能对大气环境造成污染或危害。
泄漏方向的区别
真空阀门的主要问题通常是外漏，即大气环境中的杂质可能通过填料、法兰连接处、阀体阀盖连接部位等进入阀门内腔，对介质造成污染。
常压或高压阀门则多表现为介质向外部泄漏。球阀、闸阀、截止阀等都可生产成真空阀或普通阀门，外形上区别不大，差异主要体现在连接部位和密封细节设计上。
真空阀门的特点
真空阀门工作压力低于大气压，阀瓣上的压降不能超过 1 公斤力/平方厘米。介质工作温度取决于使用装置的工艺过程，一般不超过 -70℃～+150℃。
对真空阀门最基本的要求，是保证连接部位具有高度密封性，并保证结构材料与垫片材料具有足够致密性。
按真空度分类
低真空阀门：介质压力 p=760～1 毫米汞柱。
中真空阀门：p=1×10^-3 毫米汞柱。
超高真空阀门：p≤1×10^-8 毫米汞柱。
常见结构与密封形式
真空阀门广泛采用阀杆作直线运动的真空波纹管截止阀。闸阀受到较大限制，但大通径场合也可采用球阀、柱塞阀和蝶阀。旋塞阀作为真空阀应用较少，因为旋塞阀需要油润滑，油汽可能进入真空系统，这是不允许的。
真空阀门关闭件通常采用橡胶密封圈或金属密封圈。波纹管截止阀的波纹管可采用不锈钢、高锌黄铜、塑料和其他材料。小通径截止阀可采用膜片密封；低真空和中真空场合也可采用球形旋塞阀。
technicalServices.titleEn: General Differences Between Vacuum Valves and Normal/High-Pressure Valves
technicalServices.summaryEn: Main differences between vacuum valves and normal/high-pressure valves in pressure state, leakage direction, sealing and classification.
paragraphsEn: Basic Difference

A vacuum valve is used when the valve cavity is under vacuum or negative pressure, below atmospheric pressure. It is used in vacuum pipeline systems and includes vacuum ball valves, butterfly valves and diaphragm valves. The medium usually requires high purity.

Normal-pressure and high-pressure valves operate with internal pressure higher than ambient atmospheric pressure. When leakage occurs, the medium leaks outward and may pollute or harm the environment.
Leakage Direction
For vacuum valves, external leakage is a major concern: impurities from the atmosphere may enter the valve cavity through packing, flanges or body-cover joints and contaminate the medium.

For normal or high-pressure valves, the typical concern is medium leaking outward. Ball valves, gate valves and globe valves can be made as vacuum valves or conventional valves. Their appearance may be similar, while differences are mainly in connection and sealing details.
Characteristics of Vacuum Valves
Vacuum valves work below atmospheric pressure, and pressure drop across the disc should not exceed 1 kgf/cm2. Medium temperature depends on the process and is generally within -70 C to +150 C.
The basic requirement is high sealing performance at connections and sufficient density of structure and gasket materials.
Classification by Vacuum Degree
Low vacuum valve: medium pressure p=760 to 1 mmHg.
Medium vacuum valve: p=1 x 10^-3 mmHg.
High vacuum valve: p=1 x 10^-4 to 1 x 10^-7 mmHg.
Ultra-high vacuum valve: p <= 1 x 10^-8 mmHg.
Common Structures and Seals

Vacuum bellows globe valves with linear stem movement are widely used. Gate valves are more limited, while ball valves, plunger valves and butterfly valves may be used for large diameters. Plug valves are rarely used because lubricating oil may enter the vacuum system.

Vacuum valve closures use rubber or metal sealing rings. Bellows may be made of stainless steel, high-zinc brass, plastics or other materials. Small-diameter globe valves may use diaphragm seals, and low/medium vacuum applications may use spherical plug valves.

technicalServices.title: 气动隔膜泵安装及使用
technicalServices.summary: 气动隔膜泵吸入管的管径不得小于泵入口端口径，如输送高粘度流体时，吸入管的管径最好大于泵入口口径。入口端的吸入配管必须耐用，没有皱折，才能够产生高真空状态。出口配管的管径至少要与出口径相等，或者稍微大些以降低摩擦损失。所有
paragraphs: 吸入与出口管路
气动隔膜泵吸入管管径不得小于泵入口端口径。如输送高粘度流体，吸入管管径最好大于泵入口口径。入口端吸入配管必须耐用且没有皱折，才能产生较好的真空状态。
出口配管管径至少应与出口口径相等，或稍大一些，以降低摩擦损失。所有配管及接头必须密封不漏，否则会降低泵的自吸能力。
安装重要性
如果忽略安装细节，即使前期经过细心策划、研究和选型，仍可能导致泵送效果不佳，并影响泵的使用寿命。
安装位置
噪音、安全及其他逻辑因素通常都会影响设备安装位置。有冲突要求的并联安装可能导致使用区域阻塞，并影响其他泵的安装。
使用便利性
气动隔膜泵的位置必须便于使用，方便维修人员进行日常检查和调试。
供气要求
每台气动隔膜泵应有一条通气管，且通气管应能提供足以达到理想泵送流量的空气量。气压应根据不同泵送需求确定，但不得超过 7BAR（125PSI）。
安装高度
应充分考虑气动隔膜泵的自吸能力，避免因安装高度不合理造成自吸能力下降。
管路布置
在最终决定泵位前，应充分考虑所有可能发生管路问题的位置。最佳安装位置应尽量选择在最短、最直的进出口管路连接处，避免额外弯管和管件。
泵体应能独立支撑所有管路，管路应有序排列，避免给泵体和管路装置产生应力。可安装活动软管，以消除泵自然往返动作产生的应力。
减振措施
若需将泵体与固定底座连接，在泵体与底座之间设置缓冲垫，有助于减少泵体振动。
technicalServices.titleEn: Installation and Use of Pneumatic Diaphragm Pumps
technicalServices.summaryEn: Installation, piping, air supply and vibration-reduction notes for pneumatic diaphragm pumps.
paragraphsEn: Suction and Discharge Piping

The suction pipe diameter of a pneumatic diaphragm pump must not be smaller than the pump inlet. For high-viscosity fluids, the suction pipe should preferably be larger than the inlet. The suction pipe must be durable and free of wrinkles to create good vacuum.

The discharge pipe diameter should be at least equal to the outlet diameter, or slightly larger, to reduce friction losses. All pipes and joints must be sealed, otherwise self-priming capacity will decrease.
Importance of Installation
If installation details are ignored, even careful planning, study and pump selection may still result in poor pumping performance and shorter service life.
Installation Location
Noise, safety and practical factors all influence installation location. Conflicting requirements in parallel installations may block operating space and affect other pump installations.
Ease of Use
The pump location should be easy to access so maintenance personnel can perform daily inspection and adjustment.
Air Supply
Each pneumatic diaphragm pump should have an air line capable of providing enough air for the desired pumping flow. Air pressure depends on pumping requirements but must not exceed 7 BAR (125 PSI).
Installation Height
Self-priming ability should be fully considered to avoid reduced suction performance caused by improper installation height.
Piping Layout
Before finalizing pump position, consider all possible piping issues. The best position is at the shortest and straightest inlet and outlet connections, avoiding extra elbows and fittings.

The pump body should independently support all piping, and pipes should be arranged neatly to avoid stress on the pump and piping. Flexible hoses may be installed to absorb stress caused by the pump’s reciprocating motion.
Vibration Reduction
If the pump is fixed to a base, placing a cushion between the pump body and base helps reduce vibration.

technicalServices.title: 水泵常见故障排除技巧
technicalServices.summary: 水泵常见故障排除技巧,更重要要掌握水泵的故障排除技巧，则必须知道水泵的工作原理，泵的结构构造，及必要的操作技能与机械维修常识，有了这些知识，就能根据泵不正常情况而能快速确定故障所在。水泵故障排除与处理技巧方法具体有： 1
paragraphs: 排查基础
掌握水泵故障排除技巧，首先要了解水泵的工作原理、结构构造、必要的操作技能以及机械维修常识。具备这些基础后，才能根据水泵运行中的异常表现快速判断故障位置。
泵卡住
可先用手盘动联轴器检查转动是否顺畅。若盘车困难或存在卡滞，应停机解体检查，排除动静部件之间的摩擦、碰撞或异物卡阻。
泵不排液
若灌泵不足或泵内气体未排尽，应重新灌泵并充分排气。若泵转向不对，应检查旋转方向。若转速偏低，应检查电机及传动系统并提高转速。若滤网堵塞或底阀不灵，应清理滤网、排除杂物，并检查底阀动作。若吸上高度过高或吸液槽形成真空，应降低吸上高度并检查吸液槽压力。
排液后中断
常见原因包括吸入管路漏气、灌泵时吸入侧气体未排完、吸入侧被异物突然堵塞或吸入大量气体。处理时应检查吸入侧管路连接处和填料函密封情况，必要时重新灌泵，停泵清理异物，并检查吸入口是否形成旋涡以及淹没深度是否过浅。
流量不足
流量不足可能由系统静扬程增加、管路阻力增大、止回阀等部件障碍、壳体与叶轮耐磨环磨损、轴封等部位漏液，或叶轮堵塞、磨损、腐蚀引起。应依次检查液位、系统压力、管路阻力、耐磨环、叶轮和密封部位，并根据磨损情况清洗、修理或更换。
扬程不够
扬程不足时，应检查双吸叶轮是否装反，确认液体密度和黏度是否符合设计条件，并检查实际运行流量是否过大。必要时应校正叶轮安装、调整介质工况或适当减小流量。
振动或异常声响
出现明显振动或异常声音时，应检查泵轴、电机轴、联轴器同心度、轴承状态、基础紧固情况以及泵内是否存在汽蚀、异物或部件松动。发现异常应及时停机处理，避免扩大损伤。
轴承和轴封过热
轴承过热通常与润滑不足、润滑油变质、轴承磨损、安装偏差或负荷异常有关。轴封过热则多与填料压得过紧、冷却或冲洗不足、密封面磨损有关。应按部位检查润滑、冷却、安装和磨损情况，并及时调整或更换。
转子轴向窜动过大
若转子轴向移动过大，应检查平衡装置、轴承定位、联轴器连接和转子部件磨损情况。处理时应先确认窜动来源，再进行紧固、调整或更换相关零部件。
technicalServices.titleEn: Water Pump Troubleshooting Tips
technicalServices.summaryEn: A practical guide to common water pump faults, inspection points, and corrective measures for field maintenance.
paragraphsEn: Troubleshooting Basics

Effective pump troubleshooting starts with an understanding of the pump principle, internal structure, operating skills, and basic mechanical maintenance. With that foundation, abnormal symptoms can be mapped to likely fault locations more quickly.
Pump Seizure

Turn the coupling by hand to check whether the rotating assembly moves freely. If rotation is tight or jammed, stop the pump, disassemble as needed, and remove rubbing, collision, or foreign material between stationary and rotating parts.
No Liquid Discharge

If the pump is not fully primed or air remains inside, prime and vent it again. If rotation is wrong, correct the direction. If speed is too low, inspect the motor and drive system. If the strainer is blocked or the foot valve fails, clean the strainer and repair the valve. If suction lift is too high or the suction tank is under vacuum, reduce suction height and check tank pressure.
Discharge Stops After Starting

Typical causes include air leakage in the suction line, incomplete venting during priming, sudden blockage on the suction side, or intake of excessive gas. Check suction pipe joints and packing seals, re-prime when needed, remove foreign material, and confirm that the suction inlet is not forming a vortex or operating with insufficient submergence.
Insufficient Flow

Low flow may come from increased static head, higher pipeline resistance, check valve obstruction, excessive wear of casing or impeller wear rings, leakage at seals, or a blocked, worn, or corroded impeller. Check level, system pressure, pipe resistance, wear rings, impeller, and seal points, then clean, repair, or replace parts as required.
Insufficient Head

When head is inadequate, inspect whether a double-suction impeller is installed in the correct direction, whether liquid density and viscosity match the design condition, and whether operating flow is too high. Correct the impeller, adjust the process condition, or reduce flow as needed.
Vibration or Abnormal Noise

If vibration or noise appears, check shaft alignment, coupling concentricity, bearing condition, foundation bolts, cavitation, foreign material, and loose internal parts. Stop the pump promptly when abnormal conditions are found to prevent further damage.
Bearing and Shaft Seal Overheating

Bearing overheating is often related to poor lubrication, degraded oil, worn bearings, installation deviation, or abnormal load. Shaft seal overheating is commonly caused by packing that is too tight, insufficient cooling or flushing, or worn sealing surfaces. Inspect lubrication, cooling, installation, and wear conditions, then adjust or replace parts.
Excessive Rotor Axial Movement

If rotor axial movement is excessive, inspect the balancing device, bearing positioning, coupling connection, and rotor wear. Identify the source first, then tighten, adjust, or replace the related components.

technicalServices.title: 空压机常见故障
technicalServices.summary: 在使用过程中总会出现一些故障，导致空压机运转过程中突然跳机，影响现场的使用，现列举以下空压机常见故障： 1）.空压机高温停机。 2）.空压机主机过载，主机不平衡。 3）.空压机主机异响。 在使用中我们遇到的问题大部分是这
paragraphs: 常见故障概述
空压机在使用过程中可能出现突然跳机，影响现场生产。常见问题主要集中在高温停机、主机过载或三相不平衡、主机异响三个方面。
高温停机
首先检查转子冷却液是否在规定范围内。冷却液质量和液位会直接影响风冷式螺杆空压机的散热效果，液位不足时应按规定补充。
机房通风
检查空压机房通风条件，确保设备周围环境温度处于正常范围。若现场条件受限，可在散热器位置增加导风管，改善热量排出。
散热器检查
在冷却液和环境通风正常的情况下，应检查散热器通风性。可通过透光检查判断散热器是否堵塞，透光性差时应及时清理。清理时避免用硬物直接作用在散热片上，应使用干燥气体疏通。水冷式空压机还应定期清理冷却水内部水垢，防止管路堵塞。
主机过载与不平衡
出现主机过载时，应测量三相电压是否平衡，并检查电源线接头是否松动或脱落。若三相电压不平衡，应调节外部电压或在设备附近安装稳压器。若以上项目正常，则需检查电流互感器等保护检测部件。
主机异响
主机异响常与主轴承磨损、阴阳转子间隙异常、内部润滑状态差或冷却液结焦积碳有关。发现异常声音后应及时停机检查，避免转子、轴承和主机壳体进一步损坏。
维护建议
空压机故障排查应从冷却、通风、电源、保护元件和机械磨损几个方向依次进行。日常维护中要记录温度、电流、压力和声音变化，便于提前发现趋势性问题。
technicalServices.titleEn: Common Air Compressor Faults
technicalServices.summaryEn: Common shutdown, overload, imbalance, and abnormal-noise issues in air compressor operation, with practical inspection methods.
paragraphsEn: Overview of Common Faults

Air compressors may trip unexpectedly during operation and affect production. The most common issues are high-temperature shutdown, main unit overload or three-phase imbalance, and abnormal noise from the main unit.
High Temperature Shutdown

First check whether rotor coolant is within the specified range. Coolant quality and level directly affect the heat dissipation of air-cooled screw compressors, so insufficient coolant should be replenished according to requirements.
Compressor Room Ventilation

Check ventilation around the compressor room and confirm that ambient temperature remains within the normal range. If site conditions are limited, an air guide duct can be added near the radiator to improve heat removal.
Radiator Inspection

When coolant and ventilation are normal, inspect radiator airflow. Light transmission can be used to judge blockage. If light cannot pass well, clean the radiator promptly. Avoid using hard objects on fins; use dry air for cleaning. Water-cooled compressors should also have cooling-water scale removed regularly to prevent pipe blockage.
Main Unit Overload and Imbalance

For main unit overload, measure whether three-phase voltage is balanced and check whether power cable terminals are loose or detached. If voltage is imbalanced, adjust the external supply or add a voltage stabilizer. If these checks are normal, inspect current transformers and other protection components.
Abnormal Noise

Abnormal noise is often related to worn main bearings, abnormal clearance between male and female rotors, poor lubrication, or deposits caused by degraded coolant. Stop and inspect the compressor as soon as abnormal sound appears to avoid further damage.
Maintenance Advice

Troubleshooting should proceed through cooling, ventilation, power supply, protection components, and mechanical wear. Record temperature, current, pressure, and sound changes during daily maintenance to identify trends early.

technicalServices.title: 气动调节阀的故障分析与日常维护
technicalServices.summary: 1.气动调节阀的日常维护： 当调节阀采用石墨—石棉为填料时，大约三个月应在填料上添加一次润滑油，以保证调节阀灵活好用。如发现填料压帽压得很低，则应补充填料，如发现聚四氟乙烯填料硬化，则应及时更换；应在巡回检查中注意调节阀
paragraphs: 日常维护
当调节阀采用石墨石棉填料时，约三个月应在填料处添加一次润滑油，以保证阀门动作灵活。如发现填料压帽位置过低，应及时补充填料；如发现聚四氟乙烯填料硬化，应及时更换。
巡检重点
巡回检查时应注意调节阀运行状态，检查阀位指示器与调节器输出是否一致。带定位器的调节阀应经常检查气源状态，发现气源压力异常、含水或堵塞时应及时处理。
阀门不动作
无信号、无气源时，应检查气源是否打开、气源管路是否冻结或堵塞、过滤器和减压阀是否失灵、压缩机是否故障以及气源总管是否泄漏。
有气源无信号
有气源但无控制信号时，应检查调节器、信号管路、定位器波纹管和执行机构膜片。信号泄漏、定位器漏气或膜片损坏都会导致阀门无法正常动作。
定位器故障
定位器无气源时，应检查过滤器、减压阀和供气管路。定位器有气源但无输出时，常见原因是节流孔堵塞，应清理定位器内部通道。
有信号无动作
若有信号但阀门仍不动作，应检查阀芯是否脱落、阀芯与阀座是否卡死、阀杆是否弯曲或折断、阀座和阀芯是否冻结或被焦块污物卡住，以及执行机构弹簧是否锈死。
动作不稳定
动作不稳定可能由气源压力波动、调节器输出不稳定、定位器放大器球阀磨损漏气、喷嘴挡板不平行、输出管线漏气、执行机构刚性不足或阀杆摩擦阻力变化引起。应按气源、信号、定位器、执行机构和阀体顺序排查。
technicalServices.titleEn: Fault Analysis and Daily Maintenance of Pneumatic Control Valves
technicalServices.summaryEn: Daily maintenance points and fault analysis for pneumatic control valves, including no-action and unstable-action conditions.
paragraphsEn: Daily Maintenance

When graphite-asbestos packing is used, lubricating oil should be added to the packing about every three months to keep the valve flexible. If the packing gland is too low, add packing. If PTFE packing becomes hardened, replace it promptly.
Routine Inspection Points

During patrol inspection, observe valve operation and check whether the valve position indicator matches the controller output. For valves with positioners, check the instrument air supply regularly and handle pressure abnormality, moisture, or blockage immediately.
Valve Does Not Move

If there is no signal and no air supply, check whether the air source is open, whether the air line is frozen or blocked, whether the filter or pressure reducing valve has failed, whether the compressor is faulty, and whether the main air line is leaking.
Air Supply But No Signal

If air is available but there is no control signal, inspect the controller, signal tubing, positioner bellows, and actuator diaphragm. Signal leakage, positioner leakage, or diaphragm damage can prevent normal valve movement.
Positioner Faults

If the positioner has no air supply, inspect the filter, pressure reducing valve, and supply line. If the positioner has air but no output, the throttle orifice is often blocked and should be cleaned.
Signal Present But No Action

If a signal exists but the valve does not move, check whether the plug has fallen off, whether the plug and seat are stuck, whether the stem is bent or broken, whether frozen material or coke has jammed the seat or plug, and whether the actuator spring is rusted.
Unstable Action

Unstable action may be caused by fluctuating air pressure, unstable controller output, worn or leaking amplifier ball valves in the positioner, misaligned nozzle flapper, output-line leakage, insufficient actuator stiffness, or changing stem friction. Troubleshoot in the order of air supply, signal, positioner, actuator, and valve body.

technicalServices.title: 罗茨鼓风机突发异响（声音异常）的原因分析和解决方案
technicalServices.summary: 罗茨鼓风机突发异响（声音异常）的原因分析和解决方案
paragraphs: 问题概述
罗茨鼓风机在运行中突然出现异响，应立即引起重视。声音异常往往意味着轴承、齿轮、转子、联轴器、管路压力或内部间隙出现变化，若继续运行可能造成更大机械损伤。
常见原因
异响可能来自轴承磨损或润滑不足、齿轮啮合异常、转子与机壳或转子之间擦碰、联轴器不同心、地脚螺栓松动、进口过滤器堵塞、出口压力过高或管路阀门状态异常。
排查步骤
应先观察电流、压力、温度和振动变化，再检查润滑油位、油质、轴承温度、过滤器压差、阀门开度和联轴器状态。若声音伴随剧烈振动或温升，应立即停机检查。
处理建议
轻微松动可紧固地脚和连接件；过滤器堵塞应及时清理；润滑不良应更换或补充润滑油；转子擦碰、齿轮异常或轴承损坏则应停机拆检，由专业人员调整间隙或更换零部件。
维护提示
日常应定期记录运行声音、压力、电流和温度，保持过滤器清洁，按周期检查润滑系统和联轴器。异常声音不要带病运行，应尽早排查，避免小故障发展为主机损坏。
technicalServices.titleEn: Causes and Solutions for Sudden Abnormal Noise in Roots Blowers
technicalServices.summaryEn: A text-only guide for analyzing sudden abnormal sound in Roots blowers and handling the issue safely.
paragraphsEn: Problem Overview

Sudden abnormal noise from a Roots blower during operation should be treated seriously. It often indicates changes in bearings, gears, rotors, coupling alignment, pipeline pressure, or internal clearances, and continued operation may cause larger mechanical damage.
Common Causes

Noise may come from worn bearings or poor lubrication, abnormal gear meshing, rotor-to-casing or rotor-to-rotor contact, coupling misalignment, loose foundation bolts, blocked inlet filters, high discharge pressure, or abnormal valve positions.
Inspection Steps

First observe current, pressure, temperature, and vibration changes. Then inspect oil level, oil quality, bearing temperature, filter differential pressure, valve opening, and coupling condition. If noise is accompanied by strong vibration or temperature rise, stop the blower immediately.
Recommended Treatment

Tighten loose foundations and connections, clean blocked filters, and replenish or replace lubricating oil when lubrication is poor. If rotor rubbing, gear faults, or bearing damage is suspected, stop and disassemble the machine for professional clearance adjustment or part replacement.
Maintenance Tips

Record operating sound, pressure, current, and temperature regularly. Keep filters clean and inspect the lubrication system and coupling on schedule. Do not continue running with abnormal noise; early inspection prevents minor faults from becoming main-unit damage.

technicalServices.title: 水泵维护及保养常识
technicalServices.summary: 水泵使用时的注意事项： 1、如果水泵有任何小的故障切记不能让其工作。如果水泵轴的填料完全磨损后要及时添加，如果继续使用水泵会漏气。这样带来的直接影响是电机耗能增加进而会损坏叶轮。 2、如果水泵在使用的过程中发生强烈的震动
paragraphs: 故障状态不要运行
水泵出现任何小故障都不应继续运行。若水泵轴填料已经完全磨损，应及时添加或更换；继续运行会导致漏气，增加电机能耗，并可能损坏叶轮。
强烈振动应停机
水泵运行中出现强烈振动时，应立即停机检查原因。长时间振动运行会加剧轴承、叶轮、密封和管路连接部位损伤。
底阀漏水的处理
底阀漏水时，不应向进口管内填干土再用水冲洗。干土进入泵内后会损伤叶轮和轴承，缩短水泵寿命。底阀漏水应维修，严重时更换新阀。
使用后清理
水泵使用后应将泵内积水排干。条件允许时，可卸下水管并用清水冲洗，避免泥砂和杂物长期留存在泵体及管道内。
胶带保养
水泵胶带使用后可卸下清洗，并在光照处晾干。胶带不宜放在阴暗潮湿处，也不能沾油污或涂抹黏性物质。
叶轮检查
应仔细检查叶轮是否有裂纹，叶轮与轴的固定是否松动。发现裂缝、松动或泥土附着时，应及时维修、紧固或清理。
接口密封
水泵与管道连接处必须做好密封，防止杂物进入泵内。连接不良不仅影响吸水性能，也可能造成内部部件损坏。
轴承维护
轴承是检查重点。使用后应检查轴承磨损情况，长时间运行的水泵更要关注滚珠破损和润滑状态。保养时可涂覆适量润滑油，以保护轴承和泵轴。
technicalServices.titleEn: Basic Water Pump Maintenance and Care
technicalServices.summaryEn: Daily water pump maintenance precautions covering leakage, vibration, cleaning, belts, impellers, seals, and bearings.
paragraphsEn: Do Not Run With Faults

A pump should not continue operating when even minor faults appear. If shaft packing is fully worn, add or replace it promptly. Continued operation can cause air leakage, increase motor power consumption, and damage the impeller.
Stop When Strong Vibration Appears
If strong vibration occurs during operation, stop the pump and inspect the cause. Long-term vibration can damage bearings, impellers, seals, and pipeline connections.
Handling Foot Valve Leakage

Do not put dry soil into the inlet pipe and flush it toward the foot valve. Soil entering the pump can damage the impeller and bearings and shorten service life. Repair the foot valve, or replace it when leakage is serious.
Cleaning After Use
After use, drain water from the pump. When possible, remove the pipe and flush it with clean water to prevent mud, sand, and foreign material from remaining in the pump and pipeline.
Belt Care
Remove and clean the belt after use, then dry it in light. Keep belts away from damp dark areas, oil contamination, and sticky substances.
Impeller Inspection
Inspect the impeller for cracks and check whether it is loose on the shaft. Repair, tighten, or clean the impeller promptly if cracks, looseness, or mud deposits are found.
Joint Sealing
Seal the connection between pump and pipeline carefully to prevent foreign material from entering the pump. Poor sealing affects suction performance and may damage internal parts.
Bearing Maintenance

Bearings require focused inspection. Check wear after use, especially for pumps that have run for a long time. Apply suitable lubricating oil during maintenance to protect bearings and the pump shaft.

technicalServices.title: 如何解决防爆配电箱散热问题
technicalServices.summary: 1、防爆配电箱的防爆处理 由于防爆配电箱所使用的环境有爆炸性气体或粉尘较多，这就要求防爆配电箱密封防爆，所以它的外壳不能用普通的壳体，必需用标准的防爆腔，把防爆配电箱所有的元件都装在防爆腔内。在防爆腔门上开一个观察窗，把
paragraphs: 防爆处理要求
防爆配电箱常用于含有爆炸性气体或粉尘的环境，因此必须具备密封防爆能力。外壳不能采用普通壳体，而应使用标准防爆腔，并将电气元件安装在防爆腔内。
门板与控制布置
防爆腔门上可设置观察窗，将显示部分布置在观察区域，并将启动、停止、调速等控制功能集成在防爆腔门上，方便操作和监测。
散热难点
由于元件全部安装在隔爆型防爆腔内，腔体内部空气流动受限，热量不易散出，因此散热成为防爆配电箱设计和运行中的关键问题。
热管散热技术
热管是一种高导热传热元件，通过全封闭真空管内工质的蒸发与凝结传递热量，具有导热性能高、等温性好、可远距离传热和可控温等特点。由热管组成的换热结构传热效率高、结构紧凑、阻力小。
变频器结构布置
可将主回路设计为一个大单元，安装在长方形防爆腔内后壁。后壁通过过渡散热器与IGBT模块、整流模块等发热元件结合，防爆外壳外壁加焊槽形散热器，并通过热管连接内外散热结构。
散热路径
变频器内部产生的热量经发热元件传到防爆腔后壁，再通过过渡散热器、热管和槽形散热器散发到外部，从而在保持防爆结构完整的同时降低箱内温度。
technicalServices.titleEn: How to Solve Heat Dissipation in Explosion Proof Distribution Boxes
technicalServices.summaryEn: Text-only explanation of explosion-proof enclosure requirements and heat-pipe based cooling for sealed distribution boxes.
paragraphsEn: Explosion Proof Requirements

Explosion-proof distribution boxes are used in environments with explosive gas or dust, so they must be sealed and explosion-proof. Ordinary enclosures are not suitable; a standard explosion-proof chamber should be used, with electrical components installed inside it.
Door and Control Layout
An observation window can be installed on the chamber door for display components, while start, stop, and speed control functions can be arranged on the door for convenient operation and monitoring.
Heat Dissipation Challenge

Because all components are installed inside a flameproof chamber, internal air circulation is limited and heat is difficult to remove. Heat dissipation therefore becomes a key issue in design and operation.
Heat Pipe Cooling Technology

A heat pipe is a highly conductive heat-transfer element that transfers heat through evaporation and condensation of working fluid inside a sealed vacuum tube. It has high thermal conductivity, good temperature uniformity, long-distance heat transfer capability, and controllable temperature characteristics.
Inverter Structure Layout

The main circuit can be designed as one large unit mounted on the rear wall of a rectangular explosion-proof chamber. A transition heat sink connects the rear wall with heat-generating parts such as IGBT and rectifier modules, while channel heat sinks are welded to the outside enclosure and connected by heat pipes.
Heat Transfer Path

Heat generated inside the inverter is transferred from the components to the rear wall, then through the transition heat sink, heat pipes, and external channel heat sinks. This lowers internal temperature while preserving explosion-proof integrity.

technicalServices.title: 水环式真空泵的工作原理
technicalServices.summary: 水环式真空泵的工作原理： 水环式真空泵是一种粗真空泵，它所能获得的极限真空为2000-4000帕，串联大气喷射器可达270-670帕。水环泵也可用作压缩机，称为水环式压缩机，是属于低压的压缩机，其压力范围为1-2X105
paragraphs: 设备概述
水环式真空泵是一种粗真空泵，通常可获得约2000至4000帕的极限真空，串联大气喷射器后可达到约270至670帕。水环泵也可作为低压压缩机使用。
应用范围
水环真空泵最初用于自吸水泵，后来广泛应用于石油、化工、机械、矿山、轻工、医药和食品等工业部门。在真空过滤、真空引水、真空送料、真空蒸发、真空浓缩、真空回潮和真空脱气等工艺中应用较多。
工艺特点
水环泵内气体压缩过程接近等温，因此可抽除易燃易爆气体，也可抽除含尘、含水气体。这一特点使其在粗真空获得和特殊介质抽吸场景中具有较高适用性。
水环形成
泵体内装有适量水作为工作液。叶轮旋转时，水在离心力作用下被甩向四周，形成近似等厚度的封闭水环。水环与叶轮轮毂之间形成月牙形空间。
吸气过程
月牙形空间被叶轮叶片分隔为多个小腔。叶轮旋转时，小腔容积由小变大并与吸气口相通，气体被吸入泵内。吸气结束后，小腔与吸气口隔绝。
压缩与排气
叶轮继续旋转，小腔容积由大变小，气体被压缩。当小腔与排气口相通时，压缩后的气体被排出泵外，完成一次吸气、压缩和排气循环。
technicalServices.titleEn: Working Principle of Water Ring Vacuum Pumps
technicalServices.summaryEn: Principle, application range, and suction-compression-discharge process of water ring vacuum pumps.
paragraphsEn: Equipment Overview

A water ring vacuum pump is a rough vacuum pump. It can typically reach an ultimate vacuum of about 2000 to 4000 Pa, and when connected in series with an atmospheric ejector, about 270 to 670 Pa. It can also be used as a low-pressure compressor.
Applications

Water ring pumps were first used as self-priming pumps and later became widely used in petroleum, chemical, machinery, mining, light industry, pharmaceutical, and food industries. They are common in vacuum filtration, vacuum water diversion, vacuum conveying, evaporation, concentration, conditioning, and degassing processes.
Process Characteristics

Gas compression inside a water ring pump is nearly isothermal, so the pump can handle flammable or explosive gases as well as gas containing dust or moisture. This makes it suitable for rough vacuum and special gas-handling applications.
Water Ring Formation

A suitable amount of water is placed in the pump body as the working liquid. As the impeller rotates, centrifugal force throws the water outward and forms a closed ring of nearly uniform thickness. A crescent-shaped space forms between the water ring and the impeller hub.
Suction Process

The crescent space is divided into small chambers by impeller blades. During rotation, chamber volume increases and connects with the suction port, drawing gas into the pump. After suction, the chamber is isolated from the suction port.
Compression and Discharge

As rotation continues, chamber volume decreases and compresses the gas. When the chamber connects with the discharge port, compressed gas is discharged, completing one suction, compression, and discharge cycle.

technicalServices.title: 硫化氢（H2S）环境下个人防护方案
technicalServices.summary: 硫化氢（H2S）是常用的且危险的化学物质。以下环境需要配备专用H2S防护装备 硫化氢重大事故的处理抢险人员及一线指挥员 硫化氢生产危险岗位作业人员 消防队，环保局及危险品处理小组 一、健康危害 侵入途径：吸入。 健康危害
paragraphs: 适用环境
硫化氢是常见且危险的化学物质。硫化氢重大事故抢险人员、一线指挥人员、硫化氢生产危险岗位人员、消防队、环保部门及危险品处理小组等，应配备专用硫化氢防护装备。
健康危害
硫化氢主要通过吸入侵入人体，是强烈的神经毒物，对黏膜具有强烈刺激作用。高浓度暴露可能迅速造成严重中毒，因此作业前必须评估环境浓度。
危险特性
硫化氢易燃，与空气混合可形成爆炸性混合物，遇明火或高热可能燃烧爆炸。与浓硝酸、发烟硫酸或其他强氧化剂会发生剧烈反应。其气体比空气重，可在低处扩散并在遇火源时回燃。
呼吸防护
空气中浓度超标时，应佩戴过滤式防毒面具。紧急抢救或撤离时，应佩戴氧气呼吸器或空气呼吸器，确保呼吸防护等级满足现场风险。
眼部和身体防护
眼部应佩戴全面罩或化学安全防护眼镜。身体防护可根据风险选择A级或B级带空气呼吸器的内置式防化服，手部应佩戴防化学品手套。
现场管理
作业现场严禁吸烟、进食和饮水。作业结束后应淋浴更衣，及时换洗工作服。进入罐体、受限空间或高浓度区域作业时，必须安排专人监护。
辅助检测
现场应配置便携式硫化氢检测仪和硫化氢报警器，作业前、中、后持续关注浓度变化，确保人员能够及时撤离或采取防护措施。
technicalServices.titleEn: Personal Protection Plan for Hydrogen Sulfide H2S Environments
technicalServices.summaryEn: Protective equipment and safety requirements for work in hydrogen sulfide environments.
paragraphsEn: Applicable Environments

Hydrogen sulfide is a common and dangerous chemical. Emergency responders, frontline commanders, personnel in hazardous H2S production positions, fire departments, environmental agencies, and hazardous-material teams should be equipped with dedicated H2S protective equipment.
Health Hazards

Hydrogen sulfide mainly enters the body through inhalation. It is a strong neurotoxin and strongly irritates mucous membranes. High-concentration exposure may cause severe poisoning rapidly, so environmental concentration must be assessed before work.
Hazardous Properties

Hydrogen sulfide is flammable and can form explosive mixtures with air. It may burn or explode when exposed to flame or high heat. It reacts violently with concentrated nitric acid, fuming sulfuric acid, and other strong oxidants. Because it is heavier than air, it can spread along low areas and flash back when it meets an ignition source.
Respiratory Protection

When airborne concentration exceeds limits, wear an appropriate filtering gas mask. During emergency rescue or evacuation, wear oxygen breathing apparatus or supplied-air respirators that match the site risk.
Eye and Body Protection

Use a full-face mask or chemical safety goggles for eye protection. Body protection may include Level A or Level B chemical protective clothing with built-in breathing apparatus, and hands should be protected with chemical-resistant gloves.
Site Management

Smoking, eating, and drinking are prohibited at the work site. Shower and change clothes after work, and wash contaminated workwear promptly. Entry into tanks, confined spaces, or high-concentration areas must be supervised by a dedicated attendant.
Auxiliary Detection
Portable H2S detectors and H2S alarms should be available on site. Monitor concentration before, during, and after work so personnel can evacuate or take protective action in time.

technicalServices.title: 有效解决调节阀在使用过程中经常卡住或堵塞的方法
technicalServices.summary: 调节阀以其优越的产品性能而著称，但是在使用过程中经常会莫名其妙的卡住或堵塞让人非常头疼，那么有没有什么简单的办法能防止卡住或者堵塞呢？有，当然有！ 以下是几个常见简易维护的方法： 1）卸开阀门进行清洗管路中的焊渣、铁锈、
paragraphs: 问题概述
调节阀在使用过程中可能因焊渣、铁锈、颗粒物、沉淀物或介质结晶而出现卡住或堵塞。问题多发生在开工期间、大修后投运初期或介质较脏的工况中。
拆开清洗
管路中的焊渣、铁锈和杂物容易在节流口、导向部位和下阀盖平衡孔内造成堵塞或卡住，并对阀芯曲面、导向面和密封面造成划伤或压痕。遇到这种情况，应拆开阀门清洗，清除渣物，密封面损伤时应研磨处理。
管路冲洗
检修时可打开底盖，冲掉从平衡孔掉入下阀盖内的渣物，并对管路进行冲洗。投运前让调节阀全开，使介质流动一段时间后再纳入正常控制运行。
外接气体或蒸汽冲洗
对于易沉淀或含固体颗粒的介质，普通调节阀容易在节流口和导向处堵塞。可在下阀盖底塞处外接冲刷气体或蒸汽管线，发生堵塞时打开外接阀门，在不拆阀的情况下完成冲洗。
安装管道过滤器
小口径调节阀和微小流量调节阀节流间隙较小，对介质洁净度要求高。可在阀前安装管道过滤器，阻挡杂质进入阀内，保证介质顺利通过。
改用合适阀型
直通单座阀和双座阀的节流间隙小，容易堵塞。可根据工况改用套筒阀或角形阀。套筒阀节流面积集中、窗口间隙较大，杂物较容易通过；角形阀流路自洁性较好，不易沉积堵塞。
technicalServices.titleEn: How to Prevent Control Valves from Sticking or Blocking
technicalServices.summaryEn: Practical methods for cleaning, flushing, filtering, and selecting valve types to reduce sticking or clogging in control valves.
paragraphsEn: Problem Overview
Control valves may stick or clog because of welding slag, rust, particles, deposits, or crystallized media. These issues often occur during startup, after overhaul, or in dirty-service conditions.
Disassemble and Clean

Welding slag, rust, and debris can block the throttling area, guide parts, and balance holes in the lower bonnet. They may also scratch the plug surface, guide surface, and sealing surface. In this case, disassemble and clean the valve, remove debris, and lap damaged sealing surfaces if necessary.
Pipeline Flushing

During maintenance, open the bottom cover to flush debris that has fallen into the lower bonnet from balance holes, and flush the pipeline. Before startup, keep the control valve fully open and allow medium to flow for a period before putting it into normal control service.
External Gas or Steam Flushing

For media that easily deposit or contain solid particles, ordinary control valves may clog at throttling and guide areas. A flushing gas or steam line can be connected to the lower bonnet plug. When blockage occurs, open the external valve and flush without disassembling the control valve.
Install Pipeline Filters

Small-diameter and micro-flow control valves have very narrow throttling gaps and require clean media. Installing a filter upstream of the valve can stop impurities from entering the valve and improve passage reliability.
Select a Suitable Valve Type

Straight-through single-seat and double-seat valves have small throttling gaps and are prone to blockage. Depending on the service, sleeve valves or angle valves may be better choices. Sleeve valves have larger window-type flow areas, while angle valves have better self-cleaning flow paths and are less likely to accumulate deposits.

technicalServices.title: 电磁阀安装
technicalServices.summary: 自控系统中最为广泛使用的莫属电磁阀了，电磁阀价格相对低廉、操作使用方便而且可以直接接受PLC或DCS的开关量控制信号而得到使用者的青睐。但是也有很多使用者对电磁阀的安装操作还不是很了解，以下由乾球自动化技术人员为大家简要
paragraphs: 安装前核对
电磁阀安装前，应检查型号参数是否与现场要求一致，包括电源电压、工作压力、压差和介质条件。尤其要核对电源，电源不匹配可能导致线圈损坏。
线圈安装方向
通常情况下，电磁阀线圈应竖直向上，并安装在水平管道上。若受空间或现场条件限制需要侧装，应在选型订货时说明安装环境，避免影响电磁阀正常使用。
管道清理
连接前应清理管道，尤其是新安装系统中的残留物。介质洁净度会影响电磁阀动作，若介质含尘或杂质，应在管道中安装过滤设备。
水锤防护
若介质可能产生水锤，应选择具有防水锤功能的电磁阀，或在系统中采取缓冲、防护措施，减少冲击对阀体和线圈寿命的影响。
切断阀和旁路
电磁阀前后应设置手动切断阀，并根据工况设置旁路。这样在电磁阀故障或检修时，可隔离阀门并保证系统维护便利。
流向与反装
电磁阀不能随意装反，通常应按阀体箭头方向安装，使介质流动方向与标识一致。在真空管路或特殊工况中如需反装，应确认产品结构和适用条件。
蒸汽工况
蒸汽用电磁阀入口侧应安装疏水阀，连接管道应保持适当倾斜，避免冷凝水积聚影响阀门动作。
通电时间
应尽量避免电磁阀长时间通电。长期通电会降低线圈寿命，甚至导致线圈损坏。常开型和常闭型电磁阀不能简单替换使用，应按控制逻辑正确选型。
technicalServices.titleEn: Solenoid Valve Installation
technicalServices.summaryEn: Key installation precautions for solenoid valves, including model checks, coil orientation, pipeline cleaning, bypasses, flow direction, and energized operation.
paragraphsEn: Check Before Installation

Before installation, confirm that the solenoid valve model and parameters match site requirements, including supply voltage, working pressure, differential pressure, and medium conditions. Pay special attention to voltage because mismatch may damage the coil.
Coil Orientation

In normal installation, the solenoid coil should be vertical and upward, with the valve installed on a horizontal pipeline. If side installation is required due to space or site constraints, state this during selection and ordering to avoid operation problems.
Pipeline Cleaning
Clean the pipeline before connection, especially in new systems. Medium cleanliness affects solenoid valve operation. If dust or impurities are present, install filtration equipment in the pipeline.
Water Hammer Protection
If the medium may cause water hammer, choose a solenoid valve with anti-water-hammer capability or add protective measures to reduce impact on the valve body and coil life.
Shutoff Valves and Bypass

Manual shutoff valves should be installed before and after the solenoid valve, and a bypass should be added when required by the process. This makes isolation and maintenance easier when the valve fails or needs service.
Flow Direction and Reverse Mounting

Do not install the solenoid valve in the wrong direction. In most cases, follow the arrow on the valve body so medium flow matches the marking. For vacuum lines or special services where reverse mounting is required, confirm that the product structure supports it.
Steam Service
For steam solenoid valves, install a steam trap on the inlet side and keep the connecting pipe suitably sloped to prevent condensate accumulation from affecting valve movement.
Energized Duration

Avoid keeping the solenoid valve energized for a long time. Long-term energization shortens coil life and may damage the coil. Normally open and normally closed valves cannot be interchanged casually; select according to the control logic.

technicalServices.title: 使用防爆配电箱时应注意哪些事项
technicalServices.summary: 1、施工用电配电系统应设置总配电箱、分配电箱、开关箱，并按照“总-分-开”顺序作分级设置，并形成“三级配电”模式。 2、施工用配电系统各配电箱、开关箱的安装位置要合理。总配电箱要尽量靠近变压器或外电源处，以便电源的引入。
paragraphs: 三级配电设置
施工用电配电系统应设置总配电箱、分配电箱和开关箱，并按照“总配电箱、分配电箱、开关箱”的顺序分级设置，形成规范的三级配电模式。
安装位置
各级配电箱和开关箱的安装位置应合理。总配电箱应尽量靠近变压器或外电源处，便于电源引入；分配电箱应安装在用电设备或负荷相对集中的中心位置，便于保持三相负荷平衡；开关箱应尽量靠近其控制的用电设备。
动力与照明分路
施工现场临时用电系统应尽量保证三相负荷平衡。动力用电和照明用电应形成两个独立回路，动力配电箱和照明配电箱应分别设置，避免互相干扰。
专用开关箱
施工现场所有用电设备都应有各自专用的开关箱。不得多台设备随意共用同一开关箱，以免发生误操作、过载或故障扩大。
箱体和电器标识
各级配电箱的箱体、内部设置和开关电器应符合安全规定。开关电器应标明用途，箱体应统一编号，便于管理和巡检。
停用管理
停止使用的配电箱应切断电源并上锁，防止非专业人员误操作。固定式配电箱应设置围栏，并采取防雨、防砸等保护措施。
现场安全检查
配电箱门损坏、开关处于开启状态、电缆裸露、缺少警示标识等情况都存在较大安全隐患。发现问题应及时停用整改，尤其在人流量较大的区域更要加强防护和警示。
technicalServices.titleEn: Precautions When Using Explosion Proof Distribution Boxes
technicalServices.summaryEn: Key safety points for graded distribution, installation position, load balance, switch boxes, enclosure management, and on-site protection.
paragraphsEn: Three-Level Distribution

Construction power distribution should include a main distribution box, sub-distribution boxes, and switch boxes. They should be arranged in the order of main, sub, and switch boxes to form a standardized three-level distribution system.
Installation Position

Each distribution box and switch box should be installed in a reasonable position. The main distribution box should be close to the transformer or external power source. Sub-distribution boxes should be near the center of concentrated loads to help balance three-phase loads. Switch boxes should be as close as practical to the equipment they control.
Separate Power and Lighting Circuits

Temporary construction power systems should maintain three-phase load balance. Power circuits and lighting circuits should be arranged separately, with dedicated power distribution boxes and lighting distribution boxes to avoid interference.
Dedicated Switch Boxes
Each electrical device on site should have its own dedicated switch box. Multiple devices should not casually share one switch box, as this may cause misoperation, overload, or expanded fault impact.
Enclosure and Switch Identification

Distribution box enclosures, internal arrangements, and switching devices should meet safety requirements. Switch functions should be clearly marked, and boxes should be numbered for management and inspection.
Out-of-Service Management
Distribution boxes that are not in use should be powered off and locked to prevent unauthorized operation. Fixed boxes should have barriers and protection against rain and falling objects.
Site Safety Inspection
Damaged doors, switches left on, exposed cables, or missing warning labels are serious safety risks. Stop using and rectify such boxes promptly, especially in areas with heavy pedestrian traffic.

technicalServices.title: 如何将离心风机调试到最佳状态
technicalServices.summary: 离心风机是一台构造复杂的设备，主要有进风口、风阀、叶轮、电机、出风口组成。在不同的状态下，离心风机的效果也不相同。因此，不同的部分运行状况不统一，离心风机的效果会受到影响。将离心风机调试至最佳状态，可以从以下方面入手。
paragraphs: 调试前认识设备
离心风机是一种结构较复杂的设备，主要由进风口、风阀、叶轮、电机和出风口等部分组成。不同部件的运行状态会直接影响风机效果，因此调试时应整体检查，避免单项正常但系统运行不佳。
启动方式
离心风机允许全压启动或降压启动。全压启动时电流约为额定电流的5至7倍，降压启动转矩与电压平方成正比。当电网容量不足时，应采用降压启动，降低启动冲击。
试车前检查
试车前应认真阅读产品说明书，检查接线方法是否与接线图一致，确认供电电压是否符合要求，电源是否缺相或相位异常，并检查所配电器元件容量是否满足要求。
试车人员和观察
试车时人员不少于两人，一人控制电源，一人观察风机运行情况。发现异常应立即停机检查。启动后首先确认旋转方向是否正确，并检查各相运行电流是否平衡、是否超过额定电流。
短时运行确认
风机开始运行后，可先运行约五分钟，再停机检查是否存在异常声音、振动、发热或连接松动等问题。确认无异常后，再进入连续运行调试。
双速风机调试
双速离心风机试车时，应先启动低速档，检查旋转方向是否正确。启动高速档前必须等待风机完全静止，避免高速反向旋转造成开关跳闸或电机损伤。
运行电流
离心风机达到正常转速后，应测量输入电流。运行电流不得超过额定电流，若超过额定值，应检查供电电压、风阀开度、管路阻力和电机负荷状态。
风阀调节
风机试车时，建议先关闭进口或出口管道阀门，运行后再逐渐开启阀门，直到达到所需工况。调节过程中应持续关注运行电流，防止进风口全开造成电机过载。
technicalServices.titleEn: How to Commission a Centrifugal Fan to Its Best Operating State
technicalServices.summaryEn: Commissioning points for centrifugal fans, including startup mode, wiring checks, trial operation, two-speed testing, current monitoring, and damper control.
paragraphsEn: Understand the Equipment Before Commissioning

A centrifugal fan is a relatively complex device composed mainly of inlet, damper, impeller, motor, and outlet. The operating condition of each part affects fan performance, so commissioning should check the whole system rather than one part only.
Startup Mode

Centrifugal fans may use full-voltage or reduced-voltage startup. Full-voltage startup current is about five to seven times rated current, while reduced-voltage starting torque is proportional to the square of voltage. When grid capacity is insufficient, use reduced-voltage startup to reduce impact.
Pre-Start Checks

Before trial operation, read the product manual carefully, check whether wiring matches the diagram, confirm that supply voltage meets requirements, verify that there is no phase loss or phase abnormality, and make sure electrical components have sufficient capacity.
Personnel and Observation

Trial operation should involve at least two people: one controlling power and one observing the fan. Stop immediately if abnormalities appear. After startup, first confirm rotation direction, then check whether phase currents are balanced and whether current exceeds rated value.
Short Trial Confirmation

After startup, run the fan for about five minutes, then stop and inspect for abnormal noise, vibration, overheating, or loose connections. Continue commissioning only after confirming that no abnormality exists.
Two-Speed Fan Testing

For two-speed centrifugal fans, start at low speed first and check rotation direction. Before starting high speed, wait until the fan has fully stopped to avoid reverse high-speed rotation, switch tripping, or motor damage.
Operating Current
After the fan reaches normal speed, measure input current. Operating current must not exceed rated current. If it does, inspect supply voltage, damper opening, pipeline resistance, and motor load.
Damper Adjustment

During trial operation, it is recommended to close the inlet or outlet damper first, then gradually open it after the fan starts until the required condition is reached. Monitor current continuously to prevent overload caused by a fully open inlet.
